npc_dota_hero_antimage.name: Mana Break
npc_dota_hero_antimage.description: Burns an opponent's mana on each attack and deals damage equal to a percentage of the mana burnt.

npc_dota_hero_antimage.name: Blink
npc_dota_hero_antimage.description: Short distance teleportation that allows Anti-Mage to move in and out of combat.

npc_dota_hero_antimage.name: Counterspell
npc_dota_hero_antimage.description: Passively grants magic resistance. Counterspell may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around Anti-Mage that blocks and reflects any targeted spells.

npc_dota_hero_antimage.name: Persecutor
npc_dota_hero_antimage.description: Attacks slow enemies based on how much mana they are missing. Min slow at 50% mana, up to max slow at 0% mana. No effect if enemy is above 50% mana.

npc_dota_hero_antimage.name: Mana Void
npc_dota_hero_antimage.description: For each point of mana missing by the target unit, damage is dealt to it and surrounding enemies. The main target is also mini-stunned.

npc_dota_hero_axe.name: Berserker's Call
npc_dota_hero_axe.description: Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration.

npc_dota_hero_axe.name: Battle Hunger
npc_dota_hero_axe.description: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The enemy is slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe.

npc_dota_hero_axe.name: Counter Helix
npc_dota_hero_axe.description: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies.

npc_dota_hero_axe.name: Culling Blade
npc_dota_hero_axe.description:
Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor.

Axe permanently drenches his blade every time he kills an enemy Hero with Culling Blade, gaining bonus armor for each stack.

npc_dota_hero_axe.name: One Man Army
npc_dota_hero_axe.description: Axe gains Strength based on 50% of his Armor as long as there are no allied heroes within 700 distance from Axe. The effect fades over 3s after approaching an ally.

npc_dota_hero_bane.name: Enfeeble
npc_dota_hero_bane.description: Deals damage every second and lowers the enemy's total attack damage and cast range.

npc_dota_hero_bane.name: Brain Sap
npc_dota_hero_bane.description: Feasts on the vital energies of an enemy unit, healing Bane and dealing damage.

npc_dota_hero_bane.name: Nightmare
npc_dota_hero_bane.description:
Puts the target enemy or friendly Hero to sleep. Sleeping units walk in Bane's chosen direction and are awakened when damaged. If the target was directly attacked, the Nightmare passes to the attacking unit. Bane can attack and damage Nightmared targets freely.

 Can be put on alt-cast to have the target stand still.

npc_dota_hero_bane.name: Fiend's Grip
npc_dota_hero_bane.description: CHANNELED - Grips an enemy unit, disabling it and causing heavy damage over time, while stealing mana every 0.5 seconds based on the unit's maximum mana.

npc_dota_hero_bane.name: Ichor of Nyctasha
npc_dota_hero_bane.description: Every time Bane kills an enemy hero or they die under the effect of Bane's debuff, they receive a Terror for the rest of the game that decreases their status resistance to Bane's subsequent debuffs.

npc_dota_hero_bloodseeker.name: Bloodrage
npc_dota_hero_bloodseeker.description: Drives Bloodseeker into a bloodthirsty rage which causes him to attack faster and deal more spell damage at the cost of a percentage of his health per second.

npc_dota_hero_bloodseeker.name: Blood Rite
npc_dota_hero_bloodseeker.description: Bloodseeker baptizes an area in sacred blood. After 2.9 seconds the ritual completes, causing any enemies caught in the area to take damage and become silenced.

npc_dota_hero_bloodseeker.name: Thirst
npc_dota_hero_bloodseeker.description: Bloodseeker is invigorated by the wounds of his enemies, gaining bonus movement speed when an enemy hero's health falls below 100%, with the bonuses increasing as their health falls further. If an enemy hero's health falls below 25%, he will also gain vision and True Sight of that hero. Bonuses stack per hero. Unlocks max movement speed for Bloodseeker.

npc_dota_hero_bloodseeker.name: Sanguivore
npc_dota_hero_bloodseeker.description:
Bloodseeker restores some life when he kills a unit, equal to 30 health plus a percentage of the units max health.

Restores for half values if an ally kills a nearby enemy hero.

npc_dota_hero_bloodseeker.name: Rupture
npc_dota_hero_bloodseeker.description: Causes an enemy unit's skin to rupture, dealing initial damage based on its current health. If the unit moves, it takes damage based on the distance moved.

npc_dota_hero_crystal_maiden.name: Crystal Nova
npc_dota_hero_crystal_maiden.description: A burst of damaging frost slows enemy movement in the targeted area.

npc_dota_hero_crystal_maiden.name: Frostbite
npc_dota_hero_crystal_maiden.description: Encases an enemy unit in ice, prohibiting movement and attack, while dealing damage over time. Deals 4x damage to non-ancient creeps.

npc_dota_hero_crystal_maiden.name: Arcane Aura
npc_dota_hero_crystal_maiden.description:
Gives mana regeneration to all friendly units on the map. Allies within a 1200 radius of Crystal Maiden receive more mana regeneration.

Crystal Maiden passively gains mana regen amplification.

npc_dota_hero_crystal_maiden.name: Crystal Clone
npc_dota_hero_crystal_maiden.description: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a 450 AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by Crystal Maiden's own spells.

npc_dota_hero_crystal_maiden.name: Glacial Guard
npc_dota_hero_crystal_maiden.description: A portion of the mana Crystal Maiden spends on her abilities is converted into a physical barrier.

npc_dota_hero_crystal_maiden.name: Freezing Field
npc_dota_hero_crystal_maiden.description: CHANNELED - Surrounds Crystal Maiden with 100 random icy explosions that slow enemies and deal massive damage. Lasts 10 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_drow_ranger.name: Frost Arrows
npc_dota_hero_drow_ranger.description: Adds a freezing effect to Drow's attacks, slowing enemy movement and dealing bonus damage. Slow lasts 1.5 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_drow_ranger.name: Gust
npc_dota_hero_drow_ranger.description: Releases a wave that silences and knocks back and reveals invisible enemy units. Knockback distance is relative to how close they are to Drow.

npc_dota_hero_drow_ranger.name: Multishot
npc_dota_hero_drow_ranger.description:
CHANNELED - Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying Frost Arrows. Lasts up to 1.75 seconds.

Drow can move slowly and use items while casting Multishot.

npc_dota_hero_drow_ranger.name: Glacier
npc_dota_hero_drow_ranger.description:
Drow creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and Drow and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. Drow gains additional damage while on the Glacier and attacking targets below her.

The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow. Does not interrupt Multishot when cast.

npc_dota_hero_drow_ranger.name: Precision Aura
npc_dota_hero_drow_ranger.description: Grants Drow bonus agility based on Drow's current agility and level. Nearby ranged heroes received 50% of the bonus agility.

npc_dota_hero_drow_ranger.name: Marksmanship
npc_dota_hero_drow_ranger.description: Drow's experiences in battle grant her a chance to launch arrows with incredible accuracy and effectiveness. Pierces through the enemy's defenses, ignoring their base armor. This ability is disabled if there is an enemy hero within 325 range.

npc_dota_hero_earthshaker.name: Fissure
npc_dota_hero_earthshaker.description: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.

npc_dota_hero_earthshaker.name: Enchant Totem
npc_dota_hero_earthshaker.description: Empowers Earthshaker's totem, causing it to deal extra damage and have 100 bonus attack range on the next attack.

npc_dota_hero_earthshaker.name: Aftershock
npc_dota_hero_earthshaker.description: Causes the earth to shake underfoot, adding additional damage and stuns to nearby enemy units when Earthshaker casts his abilities.

npc_dota_hero_earthshaker.name: Echo Slam
npc_dota_hero_earthshaker.description: Shockwaves travel through the ground, damaging enemy units. Each enemy hit causes an echo to damage nearby units. Real heroes cause two echoes.

npc_dota_hero_earthshaker.name: Slugger
npc_dota_hero_earthshaker.description: Enemies killed with Enchant Totem or Earthshaker's other abilities are sent flying, dealing damage to enemies they hit.

npc_dota_hero_juggernaut.name: Blade Fury
npc_dota_hero_juggernaut.description: Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with 80% magic resistance and dealing damage every 0.2s to nearby enemy units. Applies a strong dispel at the end of the spin.

npc_dota_hero_juggernaut.name: Healing Ward
npc_dota_hero_juggernaut.description: Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health. The Healing Ward moves at 325 movement speed after being summoned. Lasts 18 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_juggernaut.name: Blade Dance
npc_dota_hero_juggernaut.description: Gives Juggernaut a chance to deal critical damage with Blade Fury and on each attack.

npc_dota_hero_juggernaut.name: Swiftslash
npc_dota_hero_juggernaut.description: Performs a short Omnislash for 1 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_juggernaut.name: Bladeform
npc_dota_hero_juggernaut.description: Juggernaut gains a stack of Bladeform every 2s that Juggernaut does not take damage. Each stack grants bonus base Agility and Movement Speed. Stacks fade after 2s upon taking any damage.

npc_dota_hero_juggernaut.name: Omnislash
npc_dota_hero_juggernaut.description:
Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy units, and then slashes the target and other nearby enemy units at an increased attack rate. Juggernaut is invulnerable for the duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

npc_dota_hero_mirana.name: Starstorm
npc_dota_hero_mirana.description: Calls down a wave of meteors to damage nearby enemy units. The closest enemy unit to Mirana in a 675 radius will be struck a second time.

npc_dota_hero_mirana.name: Sacred Arrow
npc_dota_hero_mirana.description: Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun duration ranges from 0.01 to 2.6 seconds, with bonus damage up to 180 added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.

npc_dota_hero_mirana.name: Leap
npc_dota_hero_mirana.description: Mirana leaps forward into battle, empowering herself with a ferocious roar that grants bonus attack and movement speed. Speed bonus lasts 5 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_mirana.name: Celestial Quiver
npc_dota_hero_mirana.description:
When a charge is available, Mirana's next attack will deal bonus magic damage.

Gains a charge every 7 hero levels.

npc_dota_hero_mirana.name: Moonlight Shadow
npc_dota_hero_mirana.description: Turns Mirana and all allied heroes invisible and grants bonus movement speed. Mirana gains bonus outgoing damage during the duration. If a hero is revealed, invisibility will restore after the fade delay as long as Moonlight Shadow's duration has not expired.

npc_dota_hero_nevermore.name: Shadowraze
npc_dota_hero_nevermore.description: Shadow Fiend razes the ground directly in front of him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.

npc_dota_hero_nevermore.name: Shadowraze
npc_dota_hero_nevermore.description: Shadow Fiend razes the ground a short distance away from him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.

npc_dota_hero_nevermore.name: Shadowraze
npc_dota_hero_nevermore.description: Shadow Fiend razes the ground a longer distance away from him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.

npc_dota_hero_nevermore.name: Feast of Souls
npc_dota_hero_nevermore.description:
Shadow Fiend gains Bonus Movement and Attack Speed for 8 seconds. For the duration of the effect, every 0.5s he collects souls from 2 enemies in a 600 radius. After the effect is over, he loses the souls whose owners are still alive, retaining the rest for 8s, after which souls that are over the Necromastery max stack count are also lost.

 Can only collect souls once from each individual enemy.

npc_dota_hero_nevermore.name: Presence of the Dark Lord
npc_dota_hero_nevermore.description: Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor of nearby enemies.

npc_dota_hero_nevermore.name: Requiem of Souls
npc_dota_hero_nevermore.description:
Shadow Fiend gathers up to 20 of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for 0.6 seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of 2.15. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery. 

 Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.

npc_dota_hero_nevermore.name: Necromastery
npc_dota_hero_nevermore.description: Shadow Fiend steals the soul from units he kills, gaining 1.35 bonus damage per soul. Hero kills grant 4 souls. On death, he releases 30% of them from bondage.

npc_dota_hero_morphling.name: Waveform
npc_dota_hero_morphling.description: Morphling dissolves into liquid and surges forward, damaging enemy units in his path. Morphling is invulnerable during Waveform.

npc_dota_hero_morphling.name: Adaptive Strike
npc_dota_hero_morphling.description:
Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier. If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used.

Knockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.

npc_dota_hero_morphling.name: Ebb and Flow
npc_dota_hero_morphling.description: Morphling receives bonus cast range and slow resistance based on his current Strength, and attack range and movement speed based on his current Agility. These bonuses persist if he is morphed into another hero.

npc_dota_hero_morphling.name: Attribute Shift (Agility Gain)
npc_dota_hero_morphling.description: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Strength and pouring them into Agility at a rate of 4. The process is reversible.

npc_dota_hero_morphling.name: Attribute Shift (Strength Gain)
npc_dota_hero_morphling.description: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Agility and pouring them into Strength at a rate of 4. The process is reversible.

npc_dota_hero_morphling.name: Morph
npc_dota_hero_morphling.description: Morphling changes his form to match the targeted enemy, gaining their basic abilities. Can be toggled for the duration of the ability.

npc_dota_hero_morphling.name: Morph Replicate
npc_dota_hero_morphling.description: Toggles Morphling's form between his own and the replicated enemy.

npc_dota_hero_phantom_lancer.name: Spirit Lance
npc_dota_hero_phantom_lancer.description: Sends a magical spirit lance to a target enemy unit that damages and slows, while summoning an illusory phantom to attack the unit.

npc_dota_hero_phantom_lancer.name: Doppelganger
npc_dota_hero_phantom_lancer.description:
Phantom Lancer briefly vanishes from the battlefield. After 1 second, Phantom Lancer and any of his nearby illusions reappear at a random position within the targeted location, along with two additional doppelgangers. Extends duration of all illusions. The two added doppelgangers have different properties: one takes normal damage and deals none, while the other takes 500% bonus damage and deals -80% less damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

npc_dota_hero_phantom_lancer.name: Phantom Rush
npc_dota_hero_phantom_lancer.description: When targeting an enemy for an attack, Phantom Lancer quickly charges into range, gaining increased movement speed and evasion.

npc_dota_hero_phantom_lancer.name: Illusory Armaments
npc_dota_hero_phantom_lancer.description: Whenever an illusion of Phantom Lancer is created, its outgoing damage cannot go below a fixed value for 3 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_phantom_lancer.name: Juxtapose
npc_dota_hero_phantom_lancer.description: Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself. Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for 8 seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last 4 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_puck.name: Illusory Orb
npc_dota_hero_puck.description:
Vector Targeted. Puck launches a magic orb that travels along the path, damaging enemy units along the way. The orb deals an additional 3% of its impact damage every 0.5s in its area of effect, but if it exceeds the max cast range it will be destroyed.

 At any point, Puck may teleport to the orb's location using Ethereal Jaunt.

 Can be put on alt-cast to launch the Orb straight ahead.

npc_dota_hero_puck.name: Waning Rift
npc_dota_hero_puck.description: Puck teleports to the target location and releases a burst of faerie dust that deals damage and silences enemy units nearby.

npc_dota_hero_puck.name: Phase Shift
npc_dota_hero_puck.description: CHANNELED - Puck briefly shifts into another dimension where it is immune from harm.

npc_dota_hero_puck.name: Ethereal Jaunt
npc_dota_hero_puck.description: Teleports Puck to a flying Illusory Orb.

npc_dota_hero_puck.name: Puckish
npc_dota_hero_puck.description: Whenever Puck disjoints an attack, it restores 3% of its max health and mana. Dodging a targeted spell projectile restores 3x that amount. Does not apply to attacks by Towers.

npc_dota_hero_puck.name: Dream Coil
npc_dota_hero_puck.description: Creates a coil of volatile magic that latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them. If the enemy hero stretches the coil by moving too far away, it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.

npc_dota_hero_pudge.name: Meat Hook
npc_dota_hero_pudge.description: Launches a bloody hook toward a unit or location. The hook will snag the first unit it encounters, dragging the unit back to Pudge, killing it if it's a non-ancient creep and dealing damage if it is an enemy otherwise.

npc_dota_hero_pudge.name: Rot
npc_dota_hero_pudge.description: A toxic cloud that deals intense damage and slows movement--harming not only enemy units but Pudge himself.

npc_dota_hero_pudge.name: Meat Shield
npc_dota_hero_pudge.description: Pudge covers himself with a layer of flesh that blocks damage of any type taken from any source.

npc_dota_hero_pudge.name: Flesh Heap
npc_dota_hero_pudge.description: Pudge's skin thickens permanently every time he kills an enemy Hero, gaining 1.6 bonus Strength for each stack.

npc_dota_hero_pudge.name: Dismember
npc_dota_hero_pudge.description: CHANNELED - Pudge chows down on an enemy unit, disabling it and dealing damage over time. Damage is increased by Pudge's Strength and heals him for the total amount. Pudge pulls the unit at a rate of 75 units, up to a minimum of 125 range.

npc_dota_hero_razor.name: Plasma Field
npc_dota_hero_razor.description: Releases a wave of energetic plasma that grows in power as it expands, but also zaps on contraction, slowing and dealing damage to enemy units caught in its path. Damage and slow increases with distance from Razor. The Plasma Field hits each unit twice, once each direction.

npc_dota_hero_razor.name: Static Link
npc_dota_hero_razor.description: Creates a charged link between Razor and an enemy Hero, stealing damage from the target and giving it to Razor. Allows Razor to attack while moving with the link active.

npc_dota_hero_razor.name: Storm Surge
npc_dota_hero_razor.description: There's a chance when attacked, and always when targeted with a spell, to release a forked lightning that strikes the target and other nearby enemies, prioritizing the unit type of the attacker, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.

npc_dota_hero_razor.name: Eye of the Storm
npc_dota_hero_razor.description: A powerful lightning storm strikes out at the enemy unit with the lowest health, dealing damage and reducing armor.

npc_dota_hero_sand_king.name: Burrowstrike
npc_dota_hero_sand_king.description:
Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces. Adds Caustic Finale poison to heroes hit

 Can be put on alt-cast to immediately cast in the desired direction, without walking towards the targeted location.

npc_dota_hero_sand_king.name: Sand Storm
npc_dota_hero_sand_king.description: Sand King creates a fearsome sandstorm that damages enemy units and grants Sand King Invisibility while he is in it. The effect ends when Sand King leaves the area.

npc_dota_hero_sand_king.name: Stinger
npc_dota_hero_sand_king.description: Sand King strikes an area, performing an attack on all enemies in the area of effect, dealing extra damage to each. Enemies within an innermost radius of 125 take 40% extra damage. Applies Caustic Finale and a slow to all enemies hit.

npc_dota_hero_sand_king.name: Caustic Finale
npc_dota_hero_sand_king.description: Sand King's attacks inject a venom that causes enemy units to violently explode when they die that does a flat amount of damage and an additional amount based on the dying units max health.

npc_dota_hero_sand_king.name: Epicenter
npc_dota_hero_sand_king.description: After a cast point of 2 seconds, Sand King sends a disturbance into the earth, causing it to shudder violently. All enemies caught within range will take damage and become slowed. Each subsequent pulse increases the radius of damage dealt.

npc_dota_hero_storm_spirit.name: Static Remnant
npc_dota_hero_storm_spirit.description: Creates an explosively charged image of Storm Spirit that walks to the target position and lasts for 12 seconds. Will detonate and deal damage if an enemy unit comes near it.

npc_dota_hero_storm_spirit.name: Electric Vortex
npc_dota_hero_storm_spirit.description: A vortex that pulls an enemy unit to Storm Spirit's location.

npc_dota_hero_storm_spirit.name: Overload
npc_dota_hero_storm_spirit.description: Casting a spell creates an electrical charge, which is released in a burst on Storm's next attack, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.

npc_dota_hero_storm_spirit.name: Ball Lightning
npc_dota_hero_storm_spirit.description: Storm Spirit becomes volatile electricity, charging across the battlefield until he depletes his mana or reaches his target. The activation mana cost is 25+7.5% of his total mana pool, and the cost per 100 units traveled is 10+0.65% of his total mana pool. Damage is expressed in damage per 100 units traveled.

npc_dota_hero_storm_spirit.name: Galvanized
npc_dota_hero_storm_spirit.description: Storm Spirit gains a charge of 0.2 mana regeneration per kill. Loses 2 charges per death. Additionally every time he gains a charge he also gains 0.1 Mana Regen permanently.

npc_dota_hero_sven.name: Storm Hammer
npc_dota_hero_sven.description: Sven unleashes his magical gauntlet that deals damage and stuns enemy units in a small area around the target.

npc_dota_hero_sven.name: Great Cleave
npc_dota_hero_sven.description: Sven strikes with great force, cleaving all nearby enemy units with his attack.

npc_dota_hero_sven.name: Warcry
npc_dota_hero_sven.description: Sven's Warcry heartens his allied heroes for battle, increasing their armor and movement speed. Lasts 8 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_sven.name: God's Strength
npc_dota_hero_sven.description: Sven channels his rogue strength, granting bonus damage and slow resistance for 30 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_sven.name: Wrath of God
npc_dota_hero_sven.description: Sven gains additional attack damage from Strength.

npc_dota_hero_tiny.name: Avalanche
npc_dota_hero_tiny.description: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.

npc_dota_hero_tiny.name: Toss
npc_dota_hero_tiny.description: Grabs the nearest unit in a 300 radius around Tiny, ally or enemy, and launches it at the target unit or rune to deal damage where they land.

npc_dota_hero_tiny.name: Tree Grab
npc_dota_hero_tiny.description: Grabs a tree and causes Tiny to have bonus range, damage, and a splashing attack for a limited number of attacks. The tree can be thrown, to deal your attack to a unit at a distance.

npc_dota_hero_tiny.name: Tree Volley
npc_dota_hero_tiny.description: CHANNELED - Tiny channels to throw random trees within range towards the targeted area. Deals Tiny's attack with Tree Throw bonuses.

npc_dota_hero_tiny.name: Insurmountable
npc_dota_hero_tiny.description: Tiny gains Status and Slow Resistance from Strength. Slow Resistance also reduces the impact of Attack Speed slows.

npc_dota_hero_tiny.name: Grow
npc_dota_hero_tiny.description: Tiny gains craggy mass, increasing his attack damage, movement speed and armor, and toss power while slowing his attack speed.

npc_dota_hero_tiny.name: Tree Throw
npc_dota_hero_tiny.description: Throws the tree at the target unit, proccing your attack on it and splashing damage around the target.

npc_dota_hero_vengefulspirit.name: Magic Missile
npc_dota_hero_vengefulspirit.description: Fires a magic missile at an enemy unit, stunning and dealing damage.

npc_dota_hero_vengefulspirit.name: Wave of Terror
npc_dota_hero_vengefulspirit.description: Vengeful Spirit lets loose a wicked cry, weakening the total attack damage and armor of enemies, and giving vision of the path ahead.

npc_dota_hero_vengefulspirit.name: Vengeance Aura
npc_dota_hero_vengefulspirit.description: Vengeful Spirit's presence increases the damage of nearby friendly heroes. Vengeful Spirit herself receives 20% extra bonus.

npc_dota_hero_vengefulspirit.name: Retribution
npc_dota_hero_vengefulspirit.description:
Vengeful Spirit is considered both a ranged and a melee attacker to gain the respective bonuses.

When killed by an enemy hero, Vengeful Spirit deals 20% bonus damage to her killer until their next death. Only one debuff can exist at a time.

npc_dota_hero_vengefulspirit.name: Nether Swap
npc_dota_hero_vengefulspirit.description: Instantaneously swaps positions with a target Hero, friend or enemy. Nether Swap interrupts channeling abilities on the target. Enemy Swapped units take damage. Vengeful Spirit and allied swapped units gain a barrier equal to the damage dealt.

npc_dota_hero_windrunner.name: Shackleshot
npc_dota_hero_windrunner.description: Shackles the target to an enemy unit or tree in a line directly behind it. If no unit or tree is present, the stun duration is reduced to 0.6.

npc_dota_hero_windrunner.name: Powershot
npc_dota_hero_windrunner.description: CHANNELED - Windranger charges her bow for up to 1 second for a single powerful shot, which deals more damage the longer it is charged. The arrow damages and slows enemies' movement speed along its path. For each enemy that Powershot hits, its damage and slow is reduced.

npc_dota_hero_windrunner.name: Windrun
npc_dota_hero_windrunner.description: Increases movement speed and adds evasion from all physical attacks.

npc_dota_hero_windrunner.name: Gale Force
npc_dota_hero_windrunner.description: Vector Targeted. Summons a strong wind that pushes all enemies in the target area towards the target direction.

npc_dota_hero_windrunner.name: Focus Fire
npc_dota_hero_windrunner.description: Windranger channels the wind to gain 0 additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage. Extra damage from secondary item effects is not reduced.

npc_dota_hero_windrunner.name: Tailwind
npc_dota_hero_windrunner.description:
Using an ability conjures a stacking Tailwind that gives Windranger a brief burst of movement speed. Movement speed bonus gradually starts fading halfway through the Tailwind duration.

Passively increases Windranger's max movement speed.

npc_dota_hero_zuus.name: Arc Lightning
npc_dota_hero_zuus.description: Hurls a bolt of lightning that leaps through nearby enemy units that deal damage.

npc_dota_hero_zuus.name: Lightning Bolt
npc_dota_hero_zuus.description: Calls down a bolt of lightning to strike an enemy unit, causing damage and a mini-stun. When cast, Lightning Bolt briefly provides unobstructed vision and True Sight around the target in a 600 radius. Can be cast on the ground, affecting the closest enemy hero in 325 range.

npc_dota_hero_zuus.name: Heavenly Jump
npc_dota_hero_zuus.description: Zeus performs a Heavenly Jump, leaping forward and shocking the closest visible nearby enemy (prioritizing heroes), dealing damage as well as reducing their movement and attack speed. Zeus gets 900 unobstructed vision around him for 3 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_zuus.name: Nimbus
npc_dota_hero_zuus.description: Creates a storm cloud anywhere on the map that automatically casts Lightning Bolt on nearby enemies.

npc_dota_hero_zuus.name: Lightning Hands
npc_dota_hero_zuus.description: Zeus gains bonus attack speed and his attacks create Arc Lightnings that deal a percentage of its damage. Can be toggled off to stop this effect.

npc_dota_hero_zuus.name: Thundergod's Wrath
npc_dota_hero_zuus.description: Strikes all enemy heroes with a bolt of lightning, dealing damage no matter where they may be. Provides True Sight around each hero before they are struck.

npc_dota_hero_zuus.name: Static Field
npc_dota_hero_zuus.description: Zeus shocks any enemy that he attacks or is hit by his abilities, causing damage equal to a percentage of their current health.

npc_dota_hero_kunkka.name: Torrent
npc_dota_hero_kunkka.description: Summons a rising torrent that, after a short delay, hurls enemy units into the sky, stunning, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.

npc_dota_hero_kunkka.name: Tidebringer
npc_dota_hero_kunkka.description: Kunkka's legendary sword grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike.

npc_dota_hero_kunkka.name: X Marks the Spot
npc_dota_hero_kunkka.description: Targets a friendly or enemy Hero, marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds. Kunkka can trigger the return at any time during the duration. Lasts twice as long on allied heroes.

npc_dota_hero_kunkka.name: Tidal Wave
npc_dota_hero_kunkka.description: Releases a Tidal Wave that spawns behind Kunkka. Deals damage and drags enemies along it. Enemies cannot attack while being dragged.

npc_dota_hero_kunkka.name: Ghostship
npc_dota_hero_kunkka.description:
Summons a ghostly ship that sails through the battle before smashing apart, damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage.

Allied heroes touched by the Ghostship are given a 2x strong swig of The Admiral's Rum.

npc_dota_hero_kunkka.name: Return
npc_dota_hero_kunkka.description: Returns the marked hero to the X.

npc_dota_hero_lina.name: Dragon Slave
npc_dota_hero_lina.description: Lina channels the breath of a dragon, sending out a wave of fire that scorches every enemy in its path.

npc_dota_hero_lina.name: Light Strike Array
npc_dota_hero_lina.description: Summons a column of flames that damages and stuns enemies.

npc_dota_hero_lina.name: Fiery Soul
npc_dota_hero_lina.description: Grants bonus attack and movement speed each time Lina hits an enemy with a spell. Stacks with itself. Lasts 18 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_lina.name: Flame Cloak
npc_dota_hero_lina.description: Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance. Grants max fiery soul stacks on activation.

npc_dota_hero_lina.name: Slow Burn
npc_dota_hero_lina.description: Lina's abilities deal an additional 64% damage as burn damage over 4s.

npc_dota_hero_lina.name: Laguna Blade
npc_dota_hero_lina.description: Fires off a bolt of lightning at a single enemy unit, dealing massive damage.

npc_dota_hero_lich.name: Frost Blast
npc_dota_hero_lich.description: Blasts the target enemy unit with damaging frost, dealing area damage and slowing movement and attack rates for 4 seconds. The primary target receives both base and area damage.

npc_dota_hero_lich.name: Frost Shield
npc_dota_hero_lich.description: Applies a magical frost shield around the target, reducing damage from attacks against it. While the shield is active, ice magic will affect nearby enemy units every 1 seconds, dealing minor damage and slowing them.

npc_dota_hero_lich.name: Sinister Gaze
npc_dota_hero_lich.description: CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana.

npc_dota_hero_lich.name: Ice Spire
npc_dota_hero_lich.description:
Creates an Ice Spire at the target spot, slowing enemies around it. Can take 4 hero hits or 8 creep hits and when destroyed it will create a Frost Blast around it.

Chain Frost can be cast on the Spire and can bounce to the Spire and damage the spire by 1 hero attack if there are no other enemies in range.

Lich can cast Frost Shield on the Spire. Each Frost Shield tick will heal the spire by 1 hero attack.

npc_dota_hero_lich.name: Sacrifice
npc_dota_hero_lich.description:
Sacrifice an allied creep to convert its current health into mana for Lich and give Lich its experience bounty.

Begins the game on cooldown and with no charges.

npc_dota_hero_lich.name: Chain Frost
npc_dota_hero_lich.description: Releases an orb of frost that bounces between nearby enemy units up to 10 times, slowing and damaging each time it hits. Each bounce increases the damage for the subsequent bounces. Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.

npc_dota_hero_lion.name: Earth Spike
npc_dota_hero_lion.description: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units are hurled into the air, then are stunned and take damage when they fall.

npc_dota_hero_lion.name: Hex
npc_dota_hero_lion.description: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless beast, with all special abilities disabled.

npc_dota_hero_lion.name: Mana Drain
npc_dota_hero_lion.description:
CHANNELED - Channels magical energy, taking mana and slowing enemies over time. If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by 15%. 

 Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a 50% rate.

npc_dota_hero_lion.name: To Hell and Back
npc_dota_hero_lion.description:
Lion gains 20% debuff duration after killing or assisting in a Hero kill while that Hero is dead.

Lion gains 20% spell amplification for 90s after respawning or resurrecting or until he gets a kill or assist.

npc_dota_hero_lion.name: Finger of Death
npc_dota_hero_lion.description:
Rips at an enemy unit, trying to turn it inside-out, dealing massive damage to the target.

After using Finger of Death, Lion's hand becomes empowered, allowing him to use a cleaving melee attack with 250 range with bonus movement speed.

Finger of Death gains permanent bonus damage for it and the fist for each enemy Hero it or the fist kills. 

The melee attack may be disabled by setting the ability to Alt Cast.

npc_dota_hero_shadow_shaman.name: Ether Shock
npc_dota_hero_shadow_shaman.description: Creates a cone of ethereal energy that strikes multiple enemy units.

npc_dota_hero_shadow_shaman.name: Hex
npc_dota_hero_shadow_shaman.description: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless creature, disabling their attacks and abilities.

npc_dota_hero_shadow_shaman.name: Shackles
npc_dota_hero_shadow_shaman.description: CHANNELED - Magically binds an enemy unit so that it cannot move or attack, absorbing their life energy over time.

npc_dota_hero_shadow_shaman.name: Fowl Play
npc_dota_hero_shadow_shaman.description:
When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed. Incoming damage is reduced to zero for a short duration and additional chickens are created to confuse the enemy. Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

npc_dota_hero_shadow_shaman.name: Urnaconda
npc_dota_hero_shadow_shaman.description: Throw a snake jar at the target location, damaging all enemies in the AoE and creating a Massive Serpent Ward that has 4x the base Serpent Ward damage and health there that lasts 15s.

npc_dota_hero_shadow_shaman.name: Mass Serpent Ward
npc_dota_hero_shadow_shaman.description: Summons 10 Serpent Wards to attack enemy units and structures. The Wards are immune to magic. Creeps deal half damage to the Serpent Ward.

npc_dota_hero_slardar.name: Guardian Sprint
npc_dota_hero_slardar.description: Slardar slithers ahead, moving significantly faster and passing through units. Slardar has 100% slow resistance for the first 2.5s. The slow resistance gradually fades over the remaining sprint duration.

npc_dota_hero_slardar.name: Slithereen Crush
npc_dota_hero_slardar.description: Slams the ground, leaving a puddle of water, and stunning and damaging nearby enemy units. After the stun, the affected units are slowed.

npc_dota_hero_slardar.name: Bash of the Deep
npc_dota_hero_slardar.description: After 3 attacks, your next attack will bash the target.

npc_dota_hero_slardar.name: Seaborn Sentinel
npc_dota_hero_slardar.description: Slardar gains bonus movement speed, health regeneration, attack damage, and armor while in a puddle, trail, or river.

npc_dota_hero_slardar.name: Corrosive Haze
npc_dota_hero_slardar.description: Reduces enemy armor to amplify physical damage and provides True Sight and vision of the targeted unit, revealing invisibility. The enemy unit leaves a trail of water behind it.

npc_dota_hero_tidehunter.name: Gush
npc_dota_hero_tidehunter.description: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit, reducing their movement speed and armor.

npc_dota_hero_tidehunter.name: Kraken Shell
npc_dota_hero_tidehunter.description:
Thickens Tidehunter's hide to passively block a portion of any incoming physical attack damage. Reduced block amount versus creeps. The hide also removes negative status effects if the damage taken crosses a threshold.

Can be activated to double the block amount at the cost of 40% movement speed. Lasts 4s.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

npc_dota_hero_tidehunter.name: Anchor Smash
npc_dota_hero_tidehunter.description: Tidehunter swings his mighty anchor to attack and deal bonus damage to nearby enemies and reduce their attack damage. The radius of Anchor Smash is Tidehunter's attack range plus 225 units.

npc_dota_hero_tidehunter.name: Dead in the Water
npc_dota_hero_tidehunter.description: Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero. The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor. Attempting to move more than 350 units away from the anchor forces the hero to 100 move speed, dragging the anchor behind them. The anchor can be destroyed with 4 hero attacks.

npc_dota_hero_tidehunter.name: Ravage
npc_dota_hero_tidehunter.description: Slams the ground, causing tentacles to erupt in all directions, damaging and stunning all nearby enemy units.

npc_dota_hero_witch_doctor.name: Paralyzing Cask
npc_dota_hero_witch_doctor.description: Launches a cask of paralyzing powder that ricochets between enemy units, stunning and damaging those it hits. Damage increases each bounce.

npc_dota_hero_witch_doctor.name: Voodoo Restoration
npc_dota_hero_witch_doctor.description: Witch Doctor focuses his magic to heal nearby allied units, costing Witch Doctor mana every second Voodoo Restoration is active.

npc_dota_hero_witch_doctor.name: Maledict
npc_dota_hero_witch_doctor.description: Curses all enemy Heroes and player-controlled units in a small area, causing them to take a set amount of damage each second, as well as bursts of damage every 4 seconds based on how much health they have lost since the curse began.

npc_dota_hero_witch_doctor.name: Voodoo Switcheroo
npc_dota_hero_witch_doctor.description: Turns Witch Doctor into a Death Ward briefly with reduced attack speed. He is hidden during this time.

npc_dota_hero_witch_doctor.name: Gris-Gris
npc_dota_hero_witch_doctor.description:
Witch Doctor gets a Gris-Gris, an item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack. When the owner dies, 100% of the gold lost from death is added to the item, and will be refunded when the item is consumed. The value of the Gris-Gris is increased by 1 every 3s. 

 Right-click to consume and permanently remove the item.

npc_dota_hero_witch_doctor.name: Death Ward
npc_dota_hero_witch_doctor.description: CHANNELED - Summons a deadly ward to attack enemy heroes within its attack range. Lasts a maximum of 8 seconds. Death Ward has 50% bonus accuracy.

npc_dota_hero_riki.name: Smoke Screen
npc_dota_hero_riki.description: Throws down a smoke bomb, silencing enemies and causing them to miss attacks.

npc_dota_hero_riki.name: Blink Strike
npc_dota_hero_riki.description: Teleports behind the target unit, momentarily slowing them by 100% and attacking them with bonus damage if it is an enemy.

npc_dota_hero_riki.name: Tricks of the Trade
npc_dota_hero_riki.description: CHANNELED - Riki phases out of the world and periodically strikes 2 random enemy units from behind in an area around him. He has fixed attack damage while phased out.

npc_dota_hero_riki.name: Backstab
npc_dota_hero_riki.description: Every time Riki strikes his enemy from behind, he deals additional bonus damage equal to a multiple of his Agility.

npc_dota_hero_riki.name: Cloak and Dagger
npc_dota_hero_riki.description: Riki fades into the shadows, becoming invisible until he attacks. Hero kills and assists grant additional experience.

npc_dota_hero_enigma.name: Malefice
npc_dota_hero_enigma.description: Focuses Enigma's power on a target, causing it to take damage and become repeatedly stunned for multiple instances. An instance strikes every 2 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_enigma.name: Demonic Summoning
npc_dota_hero_enigma.description: Summons three fragments of Enigma himself at the cost of health. The eidolons health is increased by 3% of Enigma's current health. These eidolons are all under Enigma's control, and repeated successful attacks cause them to multiply. When this happens, the eidolons have their health restored.

npc_dota_hero_enigma.name: Midnight Pulse
npc_dota_hero_enigma.description: Steeps an area in dark resonance, dealing 5 + a percentage of the enemies current HP as damage.

npc_dota_hero_enigma.name: Event Horizon
npc_dota_hero_enigma.description: Units in a 600 radius moving away from Enigma have a movespeed penalty.

npc_dota_hero_enigma.name: Black Hole
npc_dota_hero_enigma.description: CHANNELED - Summons a vortex that sucks in nearby enemy units. Enemies affected by Black Hole cannot move, attack, or cast spells.

npc_dota_hero_tinker.name: Laser
npc_dota_hero_tinker.description: Fires an intense energy beam, damaging and blinding the target. Blinded targets miss all physical attacks.

npc_dota_hero_tinker.name: March of the Machines
npc_dota_hero_tinker.description: Enlists an army of robotic minions to destroy enemy units in an area around Tinker.

npc_dota_hero_tinker.name: Warp Flare
npc_dota_hero_tinker.description:
Throws a flare towards an enemy, dealing damage, teleporting them away, rooting them and reducing their Cast and Attack Range for 2 seconds.

The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.

npc_dota_hero_tinker.name: Keen Conveyance
npc_dota_hero_tinker.description: CHANNELED - Teleport to a target friendly structure. Level 2 allows teleporting to friendly units and Level 3 to friendly heroes.

npc_dota_hero_tinker.name: Rearm
npc_dota_hero_tinker.description: CHANNELED - Resets the cooldown on Tinker's abilities.

npc_dota_hero_tinker.name: Eureka!
npc_dota_hero_tinker.description: Tinker gains 1% item cooldown reduction per 3 Intelligence, up to a maximum of 60%.

npc_dota_hero_sniper.name: Shrapnel
npc_dota_hero_sniper.description: Consumes a charge to launch a ball of shrapnel that showers the target area in explosive pellets. Enemies are subject to damage and slowed movement. Reveals the targeted area. Shrapnel charges restore every 35 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_sniper.name: Headshot
npc_dota_hero_sniper.description: Sniper increases his accuracy, giving him a chance to deal 20 extra damage and knock back his enemies. Knockback distance increases based on how close the enemy is to Sniper. Headshots briefly slow enemy movement and attack speed by -100%.

npc_dota_hero_sniper.name: Take Aim
npc_dota_hero_sniper.description:
Passively increases Sniper's attack range by 160.

On cast, Sniper gains increased vision, Headshot chance, and attack range. Slows you by 65% for the duration and restricts your vision to a frontal cone.

npc_dota_hero_sniper.name: Concussive Grenade
npc_dota_hero_sniper.description: Launches a grenade at the target area, dealing damage to enemies and knocking them and Sniper back. Enemies affected are disarmed and have their movement slowed after the knockback.

npc_dota_hero_sniper.name: Keen Scope
npc_dota_hero_sniper.description: Sniper’s attacks deal bonus damage for every 100 units of distance Sniper is from the target.

npc_dota_hero_sniper.name: Assassinate
npc_dota_hero_sniper.description: Sniper locks onto a target enemy unit and, after a short aiming duration, fires a devastating shot that deals Sniper's attack damage plus bonus damage at long range and mini-stuns the target. Whenever Sniper kills an enemy hero, Assassinate is refreshed.

npc_dota_hero_necrolyte.name: Death Pulse
npc_dota_hero_necrolyte.description: Necrophos releases a wave of death around him, dealing damage to enemy units and healing allied units.

npc_dota_hero_necrolyte.name: Ghost Shroud
npc_dota_hero_necrolyte.description: Necrophos slips into the realm that separates the living from the dead. Unable to attack or be attacked, he emits an aura that slows enemies around him. He takes additional magic damage in this form, but his restorative powers are amplified.

npc_dota_hero_necrolyte.name: Heartstopper Aura
npc_dota_hero_necrolyte.description: Necrophos stills the hearts of his opponents, causing nearby enemy units to lose a percentage of their max health over time.

npc_dota_hero_necrolyte.name: Death Seeker
npc_dota_hero_necrolyte.description: Necrophos turns into a large Death Pulse towards the target unit's position. Once it arrives to the location, the Death Pulse spreads towards nearby enemies and allies.

npc_dota_hero_necrolyte.name: Sadist
npc_dota_hero_necrolyte.description: Necrophos gains stacking regen for 8 seconds for each unit he kills. Hero kills multiply the effect.

npc_dota_hero_necrolyte.name: Reaper's Scythe
npc_dota_hero_necrolyte.description: Stuns the target enemy hero, then deals damage based on how much life it is missing. If Necrophos kills an enemy this way, he'll permanently gain Health and Mana Regen. Any kill under this effect is credited to Necrophos.

npc_dota_hero_warlock.name: Fatal Bonds
npc_dota_hero_warlock.description: Binds several visible enemy units together, causing a percentage of the damage dealt to one of them to be felt by the others.

npc_dota_hero_warlock.name: Shadow Word
npc_dota_hero_warlock.description: Warlock whispers an incantation, casting a spell on a unit that makes it deal damage to nearby enemy units and heal nearby ally units. Target Unit will also heal or be damaged depending on whether they are ally or enemy.

npc_dota_hero_warlock.name: Upheaval
npc_dota_hero_warlock.description: CHANNELED - A powerful slowing and damaging current that grows stronger as it's channeled. Lasts up to 10 seconds. Enemies are slowed for 1 second after leaving the area or the spell ends.

npc_dota_hero_warlock.name: Eldritch Summoning
npc_dota_hero_warlock.description: Whenever an enemy unit dies while afflicted by one or more of Warlock's abilities, a minor imp is summoned that lasts for 15 seconds and explodes on death. Imps will automatically seek out nearby units, favoring fatally bonded heroes, and will explode when reaching their prey.

npc_dota_hero_warlock.name: Chaotic Offering
npc_dota_hero_warlock.description: Summons a Golem from the depths, stunning enemies for 0.8 seconds. The Golem lives 60 seconds, takes reduced damage from spells, has increased Slow Resistance, has Permanent Immolation and Flaming Fists on attack.

npc_dota_hero_beastmaster.name: Wild Axes
npc_dota_hero_beastmaster.description: Beastmaster sends his axes flying and calls them home again, slicing through enemy units and trees along their path. Each axe can hit an enemy once, and amplifies subsequent damage from Beastmaster and his units.

npc_dota_hero_beastmaster.name: Summon Razorback
npc_dota_hero_beastmaster.description: Beastmaster calls forth a Boar to aid in the battlefield. The Boar has a passive poison attack that slows attack and movement speeds.

npc_dota_hero_beastmaster.name: Summon Raptors
npc_dota_hero_beastmaster.description: Beastmaster summons 2 hawks that circle around Beastmaster and dive-bombs at enemies with a base attack rate of every 4s, damaging and rooting them. Attack rate increases with the Hawk's attack speed. Prioritizes heroes.

npc_dota_hero_beastmaster.name: Inner Beast
npc_dota_hero_beastmaster.description: Untaps the inner fury of Beastmaster and units he controls, passively increasing their attack speed.

npc_dota_hero_beastmaster.name: Drums of Slom
npc_dota_hero_beastmaster.description:
Attacks from Beastmaster or a nearby unit he controls will cause him bang his drum, dealing damage to nearby units and healing Beastmaster and units under his control for a portion of the damage dealt. Every attack decreases the interval between drum hits down to a minimum of 0.5s between hits after 20 attacks. If no attacks are made, the intervals gradually increase.

Using Primal Roar counts as 10 attacks.

npc_dota_hero_beastmaster.name: Primal Roar
npc_dota_hero_beastmaster.description: Beastmaster lets loose a deafening roar that stuns, and shoves open a path to its target. All units in the path of the roar are damaged, while units shoved aside by the roar have their movement and attack speed slowed. Additionally, Beastmaster and his units gain 40% movement speed for 2 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_queenofpain.name: Shadow Strike
npc_dota_hero_queenofpain.description: Hurls a poisoned dagger which deals large initial damage, and then deals damage over time. The poisoned unit has its movement speed slowed for 16 seconds. An instance of damage is dealt every 3 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_queenofpain.name: Blink
npc_dota_hero_queenofpain.description: Short distance teleportation that allows Queen of Pain to move in and out of combat.

npc_dota_hero_queenofpain.name: Scream Of Pain
npc_dota_hero_queenofpain.description:
The Queen of Pain lets loose a piercing scream around her, damaging nearby enemies.

25% of the damage dealt to heroes is reflected back to her.

npc_dota_hero_queenofpain.name: Succubus
npc_dota_hero_queenofpain.description: All sources of Spell Lifesteal also apply to Pure Damage. Queen of Pain gains Spell Lifesteal that increases with proximity to her enemies. Lifesteal is at its maximum when the enemy is 150 units or closer to her and at its minimum when the enemy is 800 units or further from her.

npc_dota_hero_queenofpain.name: Sonic Wave
npc_dota_hero_queenofpain.description: Creates a gigantic wave of sound in front of Queen of Pain, dealing heavy damage to all enemy units in its wake and pushing them back.

npc_dota_hero_venomancer.name: Venomous Gale
npc_dota_hero_venomancer.description: Launches a ball of venom in a line, poisoning enemy units so that they take both initial damage and damage over time, as well as suffering slowed movement. Venomous Gale deals damage every 3 seconds over its duration.

npc_dota_hero_venomancer.name: Snakebite
npc_dota_hero_venomancer.description: Venomancer summons a Spawn of Aktok to sink its fangs into a target, dealing magic damage and applying a toxin that does damage every second. When the target attacks while infected, they take the initial damage again.

npc_dota_hero_venomancer.name: Plague Ward
npc_dota_hero_venomancer.description: Summons a plague ward to attack enemy units and structures. The ward is immune to magic. Wards gain the Poison Sting level from Venomancer, dealing 50% of the full damage.

npc_dota_hero_venomancer.name: Poison Sting
npc_dota_hero_venomancer.description: Venomancer's attacks slow enemies and deal damage over time.

npc_dota_hero_venomancer.name: Noxious Plague
npc_dota_hero_venomancer.description: Infects an enemy with a plague that does damage on application then slows the target and deals damage over time based on their maximum health. When the debuff ends for any reason, all debuffs from Venomancer on the initial target and the plague are spread to nearby targets. Additional spreads beyond the first do not deal impact damage.

npc_dota_hero_faceless_void.name: Time Walk
npc_dota_hero_faceless_void.description: Rushes to a target location while backtracking any damage taken the last 2 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_faceless_void.name: Time Dilation
npc_dota_hero_faceless_void.description: Faceless Void envelops nearby enemies with time dilating fields to slow cooldown progression of their abilities. Each enveloped enemy gains one Time Dilation stack when applied, and one stack per ability they have on cooldown. Each stack deals damage per second and slows movement and attack speed. The duration is paused while affected by Chronosphere.

npc_dota_hero_faceless_void.name: Time Lock
npc_dota_hero_faceless_void.description: Adds the chance for an attack to lock an enemy unit in time while attacking it a second time.

npc_dota_hero_faceless_void.name: Reverse Time Walk
npc_dota_hero_faceless_void.description: Available for 1.5 seconds after landing Time Walk. If used in this period, you will reverse your time walk back to your previous cast location. Does not affect health or proc scepter hits.

npc_dota_hero_faceless_void.name: Distortion Field
npc_dota_hero_faceless_void.description: Enemy Attack Projectiles targetting Faceless Void or allied heroes within a 1200 radius of him get slowed by 40%, when they get within 500 distance of their target.

npc_dota_hero_faceless_void.name: Chronosphere
npc_dota_hero_faceless_void.description: Creates a blister in spacetime, trapping all units caught in its sphere of influence and causes you to move very quickly inside it. Only Faceless Void and any units he controls are unaffected. Invisible enemies in the sphere will be revealed.

npc_dota_hero_skeleton_king.name: Wraithfire Blast
npc_dota_hero_skeleton_king.description: Wraith King sears an enemy unit with spectral fire, dealing damage and stunning, then dealing damage over time and slowing the target.

npc_dota_hero_skeleton_king.name: Bone Guard
npc_dota_hero_skeleton_king.description: Gains a Charge for every 2 creeps killed and 2 charges per hero killed. Activate to spend all charges, summoning skeletons that respawn once when killed. Skeletons benefit from Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal.

npc_dota_hero_skeleton_king.name: Mortal Strike
npc_dota_hero_skeleton_king.description: Wraith King passively deals bonus damage on an attack with a cooldown.

npc_dota_hero_skeleton_king.name: Vampiric Spirit
npc_dota_hero_skeleton_king.description: Grants Wraith King Lifesteal. When slain Wraith King turns into a free pathing Wraith with Bonus Attack and Movement Speed for a short duration, delaying his death. Wraith King cannot reincarnate after being a Wraith.

npc_dota_hero_skeleton_king.name: Reincarnation
npc_dota_hero_skeleton_king.description: Wraith King's form regroups after death, allowing him to resurrect when killed in battle. Upon death, enemy units in a 600 radius are slowed. Skeletons spawn and attack each nearby enemy hero. Can be self-cast to kill Wraith King instantly.

npc_dota_hero_death_prophet.name: Crypt Swarm
npc_dota_hero_death_prophet.description: Sends a swarm of winged beasts to savage enemy units in front of Death Prophet.

npc_dota_hero_death_prophet.name: Silence
npc_dota_hero_death_prophet.description: Fires a projectile that prevents enemy units in a target area from casting spells.

npc_dota_hero_death_prophet.name: Spirit Siphon
npc_dota_hero_death_prophet.description: Creates a spirit link between Death Prophet and an enemy unit, draining health from the enemy.

npc_dota_hero_death_prophet.name: Exorcism
npc_dota_hero_death_prophet.description: Unleashes evil spirits to drain the life of nearby enemy units and structures. Spirits need to return back to Death Prophet in order to attack again. At the end of the spell's duration, Death Prophet is healed in proportion to the damage dealt. Deals 50% damage to buildings. Lasts 40 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_phantom_assassin.name: Stifling Dagger
npc_dota_hero_phantom_assassin.description: Throws a dagger slowing the enemy unit's movement speed, dealing 65+30% of Phantom Assassin's attack damage as physical damage and applying attack effects from items and abilities.

npc_dota_hero_phantom_assassin.name: Phantom Strike
npc_dota_hero_phantom_assassin.description: Teleports to a unit, friendly or enemy, and grants bonus attack speed while attacking if it's an enemy unit.

npc_dota_hero_phantom_assassin.name: Blur
npc_dota_hero_phantom_assassin.description: Phantom Assassin blurs her body, disjointing incoming projectiles, increasing her movement speed, causing her to be impossible to see until she comes near enemy heroes or towers.

npc_dota_hero_phantom_assassin.name: Fan of Knives
npc_dota_hero_phantom_assassin.description: Phantom Assassin releases sharp blades around her, dealing a percentage of each victim's max health on impact and applying Break.

npc_dota_hero_phantom_assassin.name: Immaterial
npc_dota_hero_phantom_assassin.description:
Phantom Assassin focuses inward, increasing her ability to evade enemy attacks. Evasion improves with Phantom Assassin's levels. 

Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

npc_dota_hero_phantom_assassin.name: Coup de Grace
npc_dota_hero_phantom_assassin.description: Phantom Assassin refines her combat abilities, acquiring a chance of gaining Deadly Focus with each attack. When attacking with Deadly Focus, Phantom Assassin will consume the buff and guarantee a critical hit. Stifling Dagger has a bonus chance to cause Deadly Focus.

npc_dota_hero_pugna.name: Nether Blast
npc_dota_hero_pugna.description: An exploding pulse deals damage to enemies and structures in the area. Deals 65% damage to structures.

npc_dota_hero_pugna.name: Decrepify
npc_dota_hero_pugna.description: A powerful banishing spell that slows a unit and renders it unable to attack or be attacked. Healing on affected allies is increased, while afflicted enemies take extra magic damage instead.

npc_dota_hero_pugna.name: Nether Ward
npc_dota_hero_pugna.description: Pugna places a Nether Ward at the target location. The ward will fire at any enemy hero who casts a spell dealing base damage plus the damage multiplier of the mana spent by the enemy hero.

npc_dota_hero_pugna.name: Oblivion Savant
npc_dota_hero_pugna.description:
Pugna can cast spells and use items while channeling.

Pugna receives 1.5% spell amplification per destroyed tower.

npc_dota_hero_pugna.name: Life Drain
npc_dota_hero_pugna.description:
CHANNELED - When cast on an enemy, Pugna drains health from the target enemy unit to heal himself and granting vision over the target.

When cast on an ally, Pugna will drain his own health into his ally.

npc_dota_hero_templar_assassin.name: Refraction
npc_dota_hero_templar_assassin.description: Templar Assassin becomes highly elusive, gaining a small barrier and bonus to her damage. The damage and avoidance effects are separate, and have a limited number of instances. If a barrier is consumed, a new one is created as long as there are charges left. If an instance of damage would deal more damage than the remaining barrier, all of the damage is absorbed.

npc_dota_hero_templar_assassin.name: Meld
npc_dota_hero_templar_assassin.description: Templar Assassin conceals herself, becoming invisible as long as she remains still. If Meld's invisibility is broken by attacking an enemy, Lanaya's attack will deal bonus damage to the enemy and reduce their armor for 6 seconds. Bonus damage and armor reductions are applied to all enemies in the Psi Blades split range.

npc_dota_hero_templar_assassin.name: Psi Blades
npc_dota_hero_templar_assassin.description: Templar Assassin's psi blades slice through the attacked unit, splitting and damaging enemy units directly behind it, while gaining bonus attack range. For each unit it damages, the split damage is reduced by a percentage.

npc_dota_hero_templar_assassin.name: Trap
npc_dota_hero_templar_assassin.description:
Springs the trap nearest to Templar Assassin, slowing nearby enemies. 

If the ability is in alt-cast state, springs the trap that is closest to the mouse cursor.

npc_dota_hero_templar_assassin.name: Psionic Projection
npc_dota_hero_templar_assassin.description: CHANNELED - Allows Templar Assassin to teleport to any Psionic Trap after channeling for 2 seconds, detonating it upon arrival as if it was fully charged and instantly dealing 400 bonus damage. Channeling Psionic Projection does not break Meld.

npc_dota_hero_templar_assassin.name: Psionic Trap
npc_dota_hero_templar_assassin.description: Templar Assassin places mystical traps that invisibly monitor enemy movement. When sprung at her command, they exert a slowing influence of 20% in a 400 radius. Trap movement slow charges up to 50% after 3.5 seconds. Deals damage after 3.5s.

npc_dota_hero_templar_assassin.name: Inner Peace
npc_dota_hero_templar_assassin.description: When remaining stationary and not taking damage for 0.25s, Templar Assassin begins meditating, gaining health and mana regeneration, reaching the maximum bonus after 2.05s of meditating.

npc_dota_hero_viper.name: Poison Attack
npc_dota_hero_viper.description: Intensifies Viper's venom, adding an effect to his normal attack that applies a stacking movement speed slow and magic resistance deduction while dealing damage over time. Stacks up to 6 times.

npc_dota_hero_viper.name: Nethertoxin
npc_dota_hero_viper.description: Viper releases a Nethertoxin at the targeted area. Units in that area take an increasing damage over time based on how long they remain in it. Units in it have their attack speed slowed.

npc_dota_hero_viper.name: Corrosive Skin
npc_dota_hero_viper.description: Viper exudes an infectious toxin that damages and slows the attack speed of any enemy that damages it in a 1200 radius. The acid exudate also increases Viper's resistance to magic.

npc_dota_hero_viper.name: Nosedive
npc_dota_hero_viper.description: Viper slams into the ground, releasing a Nethertoxin and splattering each enemy in a 500 AoE for 4 seconds with the effect of Corrosive Skin.

npc_dota_hero_viper.name: Viper Strike
npc_dota_hero_viper.description: Viper slows the targeted enemy unit's movement and attack speed while also disabling their passives and dealing poison damage over time. The slowing effect reduces over the duration of the poison.

npc_dota_hero_luna.name: Lucent Beam
npc_dota_hero_luna.description: Calls a beam of lunar energy down upon an enemy, damaging and briefly stunning them.

npc_dota_hero_luna.name: Lunar Orbit
npc_dota_hero_luna.description: Creates 4 glaives that rotate 225 radius around Luna. Any enemy unit that collides with a glaive will take a percentage of Luna's Attack Damage.

npc_dota_hero_luna.name: Moon Glaives
npc_dota_hero_luna.description: Empowers Luna's glaives, causing her attacks to bounce between enemy units. Deals less damage with each bounce.

npc_dota_hero_luna.name: Lunar Blessing
npc_dota_hero_luna.description: Grants attack damage to Luna and nearby allied heroes within 1200 range, with Luna receiving double the attack damage bonuses. At night, Lunar Blessing is global, and Luna is blessed with bonus night vision.

npc_dota_hero_luna.name: Eclipse
npc_dota_hero_luna.description: Showers random nearby enemies with strikes from Luna's current level of Lucent Beam. These beams do not stun their targets, and there is a maximum number of times that a single target can be struck. Also turns day into night for a short time.

npc_dota_hero_dragon_knight.name: Breathe Fire
npc_dota_hero_dragon_knight.description: Unleashes a breath of fire in front of Dragon Knight that burns enemies and reduces the damage their attacks deal.

npc_dota_hero_dragon_knight.name: Dragon Tail
npc_dota_hero_dragon_knight.description: Dragon Knight smites an enemy unit with his shield, stunning and damaging it and units close to it.

npc_dota_hero_dragon_knight.name: Wyrm's Wrath
npc_dota_hero_dragon_knight.description: The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's abilities and items to have increased AoE and causes his attacks to deal additional magic damage to enemy units.

npc_dota_hero_dragon_knight.name: Fireball
npc_dota_hero_dragon_knight.description: Ignites an area, dealing damage over time that lingers on enemies in it. Has reduced cast range when melee.

npc_dota_hero_dragon_knight.name: Dragon Blood
npc_dota_hero_dragon_knight.description:
The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's health regeneration and armor. 

Regen and armor are increased by 50% during Elder Dragon Form.

npc_dota_hero_dragon_knight.name: Elder Dragon Form
npc_dota_hero_dragon_knight.description:
Dragon Knight assumes the form of the Elder Dragon, increasing the range of his abilities, gaining bonus movement speed, and a ranged attack with various properties. The Dragon evolves per level. The bonuses are cumulative. 

Level 1 Green: Grants a corrosive damage over time that can also damage buildings.

Level 2 Red: Grants splash damage to the dragon's attacks.

Level 3 Blue: Grants a debuff immunity piercing movement and attack frost slow on attack.

npc_dota_hero_dazzle.name: Poison Touch
npc_dota_hero_dazzle.description: Releases a cone of poison that strikes multiple enemy units. Deals damage over time and slows the targets. Anytime the targets get attacked by Dazzle, the debuff duration is refreshed and slow is increased.

npc_dota_hero_dazzle.name: Shallow Grave
npc_dota_hero_dazzle.description: An ally blessed with Shallow Grave, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection. Healing on that ally is also amplified for the duration based on the hero's HP.

npc_dota_hero_dazzle.name: Shadow Wave
npc_dota_hero_dazzle.description: Sends out a bolt of power that arcs between allies, healing them while damaging any enemy units standing nearby. Dazzle is always healed by Shadow Wave.

npc_dota_hero_dazzle.name: Weave
npc_dota_hero_dazzle.description: Dazzle's abilities apply Weave to both allies and enemies they affect, increasing allied armor and reducing enemy armor. Multiple instances of this effect stack.

npc_dota_hero_dazzle.name: Nothl Projection
npc_dota_hero_dazzle.description: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.

npc_dota_hero_dazzle.name: End Projection
npc_dota_hero_dazzle.description: Ends Dazzle's sojourn in the Nothl Realm and returns his spirit to his body.

npc_dota_hero_rattletrap.name: Battery Assault
npc_dota_hero_rattletrap.description: Discharges high-powered shrapnel at random nearby enemy units, dealing minor magical damage and ministun.

npc_dota_hero_rattletrap.name: Power Cogs
npc_dota_hero_rattletrap.description:
Forms a ring of energized cogs around Clockwerk, trapping any units that are near. Enemies outside the trap that touch a cog are knocked back, losing health and mana. Once a cog has delivered a shock, it will power down. Damage is increased by 50% of the mana burned.

 Cogs can be destroyed by enemy attacks, but Clockwerk can push them up to 1000 distance away with one hit. Clockwerk can move through the cogs freely, disabling them as he passes over.

npc_dota_hero_rattletrap.name: Rocket Flare
npc_dota_hero_rattletrap.description: Fires a global range flare that explodes over a given area. Upon impact, enemies in the area take damage and are briefly slowed. Rocket flare provides vision over the impact area for 6 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_rattletrap.name: Overclocking
npc_dota_hero_rattletrap.description:
Supercharges Clockwerks abilities:

Battery Assault: Increased radius and affects all enemies in its range.
Power Cogs: Radius increased, and Clockwerk's armor while near Power Cogs is increased.
Rocket Flares: Increased damage, vision and slow duration, and fire additional rockets to either side of the target.
Hookshot: Stun radius and duration increased.
Jetpack Moves faster.

Clockwerk's movement and attack speed becomes slowed to a crawl after the duration runs out.

npc_dota_hero_rattletrap.name: Jetpack
npc_dota_hero_rattletrap.description: Clockwerk activates a jetpack, gaining flying movement, flying vision, and bonus movement speed. Clockwerk has a severely-limited turn rate during this time and cannot attack. Jetpack can be toggled on and off for the duration of the buff.

npc_dota_hero_rattletrap.name: Hookshot
npc_dota_hero_rattletrap.description: Fires a grappling device rapidly at the target location. If the hook hits a unit, Clockwerk launches himself into the target, stunning and dealing damage to everyone in a 175 radius around the hit target. Any enemies Clockwerk collides with along the way are damaged and stunned.

npc_dota_hero_rattletrap.name: Armor Power
npc_dota_hero_rattletrap.description:
Clockwerk's outgoing damage increases by 0.25% per point of armor.

Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +4 armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.

npc_dota_hero_leshrac.name: Split Earth
npc_dota_hero_leshrac.description: Splits the earth under enemies. Deals damage and stuns for a short duration.

npc_dota_hero_leshrac.name: Diabolic Edict
npc_dota_hero_leshrac.description: Saturates the area around Leshrac with magical explosions that deal pure damage to enemy units and buildings. The fewer units available to attack, the more damage those units will take.

npc_dota_hero_leshrac.name: Lightning Storm
npc_dota_hero_leshrac.description: Summons a lightning storm that blasts the target enemy unit, then strikes any nearby enemy units. Struck enemies have their move speed slowed.

npc_dota_hero_leshrac.name: Nihilism
npc_dota_hero_leshrac.description: Causes Leshrac and all nearby enemies to turn ethereal, preventing them from attacking, slowing them, and making them take more magic damage. Increases Leshrac's speed rather than reducing it. Does not cause Leshrac to take amplified damage.

npc_dota_hero_leshrac.name: Pulse Nova
npc_dota_hero_leshrac.description: Creates waves of damaging energy around Leshrac, one per second, to damage nearby enemy units. Drains Leshrac's mana with each pulse.

npc_dota_hero_furion.name: Sprout
npc_dota_hero_furion.description: Sprouts a ring of trees around a unit, damaging and trapping it in place and providing vision in a 400 radius.

npc_dota_hero_furion.name: Teleportation
npc_dota_hero_furion.description: Teleports to any point on the map. Gains a barrier after arriving to its destination.

npc_dota_hero_furion.name: Nature's Call
npc_dota_hero_furion.description: Converts an area of trees into Treants under the command of Nature's Prophet.

npc_dota_hero_furion.name: Curse of the Oldgrowth
npc_dota_hero_furion.description: Applies a curse on all enemy heroes within 900 range, displaying them in fog, slowing them, and dealing damage over time based on the number of trees within 250 radius. Treants count as trees for this purpose.

npc_dota_hero_furion.name: Spirit of the Forest
npc_dota_hero_furion.description: Nature's Prophet gains 2% bonus damage for each nearby tree. Treants also provide this bonus with multiplied values and with larger radius. Treants also possess this ability.

npc_dota_hero_furion.name: Wrath of Nature
npc_dota_hero_furion.description: Damaging energy bounces around the map, striking enemies that are in vision starting with those closest to the cast point. Each enemy hit beyond the first adds damage, up to the maximum after 16 are hit.

npc_dota_hero_life_stealer.name: Rage
npc_dota_hero_life_stealer.description:
Launch into a maddened rage, becoming Debuff Immune, increasing magic resistance and gaining movement speed.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

npc_dota_hero_life_stealer.name: Open Wounds
npc_dota_hero_life_stealer.description: Lifestealer rends an enemy unit, slowing the victim's movement speed and allowing all allies to regain health for a percentage of the damage they deal to that unit. The victim recovers movement speed over the duration.

npc_dota_hero_life_stealer.name: Feast
npc_dota_hero_life_stealer.description: Lifestealer's attacks deal damage and provide heal for a percentage of his target's max health. He gains permanent max HP whenever he kills a unit.

npc_dota_hero_life_stealer.name: Infest
npc_dota_hero_life_stealer.description:
Lifestealer infests the body of a target unit, becoming undetectable, and healing for a portion of his max hitpoints every second while inside. He can then explode from the host body, dealing damage to nearby enemies. If the infested unit is an enemy creep or a neutral creep, he can take control of the unit's ability to move and attack, and the creep loses a portion of their max hitpoints over time. Does not work on enemy heroes.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

npc_dota_hero_life_stealer.name: Consume
npc_dota_hero_life_stealer.description: Lifestealer eats the host body from the inside out, exploding from within.

npc_dota_hero_dark_seer.name: Vacuum
npc_dota_hero_dark_seer.description: Dark Seer creates a vacuum over the target area that sucks in enemy units, disrupting them and dealing damage.

npc_dota_hero_dark_seer.name: Ion Shell
npc_dota_hero_dark_seer.description: Surrounds the target unit with a bristling shield that damages enemy units in an area around it.

npc_dota_hero_dark_seer.name: Surge
npc_dota_hero_dark_seer.description: Charges a target friendly unit with power, giving it a brief burst of phased movement speed. Allows the unit to reach maximum movement speed and cannot be slowed.

npc_dota_hero_dark_seer.name: Normal Punch
npc_dota_hero_dark_seer.description: Passive ability. Causes Dark Seer's next attack on a hero to have True Strike, knock a replica out of the victim, damaging and stunning them based on how far Dark Seer has moved in the past 3 seconds. Max power is reached after 1100 distance moved.

npc_dota_hero_dark_seer.name: Quick Wit
npc_dota_hero_dark_seer.description:
Dark Seer gains 1 Attack Speed from each point of Intelligence.

When Dark Seer levels up, he restores a percentage of his max health and mana.

npc_dota_hero_dark_seer.name: Wall of Replica
npc_dota_hero_dark_seer.description: Raises a wall of warping light that slows, damages, and creates replicas of any enemy hero who crosses it. Enemy replicas serve at the Dark Seer's will. Replicas last until they are destroyed, or until the wall's duration ends.

npc_dota_hero_clinkz.name: Strafe
npc_dota_hero_clinkz.description:
Clinkz gains attack speed and has bonus attack range. Any current Skeleton Archers within a 1200 radius of Clinkz also gain bonus attack range and 40% of the attack speed bonus. 

 Casting Strafe does not break Skeleton Walk invisibility.

npc_dota_hero_clinkz.name: Searing Arrows
npc_dota_hero_clinkz.description:
Imbues Clinkz's arrows with fire for extra damage.

Skeleton Archers will fire Searing Arrows at targets Clinkz attacks for 50% damage.

npc_dota_hero_clinkz.name: Death Pact
npc_dota_hero_clinkz.description: Clinkz consumes the target enemy creep or friendly Skeleton Archer, healing and gaining max health. Does not take Clinkz out of Skeleton Walk.

npc_dota_hero_clinkz.name: Burning Barrage
npc_dota_hero_clinkz.description: CHANNELED - Clinkz channels and shoots multiple piercing arrows in the target direction that hit all enemy units dealing a percentage of Clinkz' attack damage and applying attack modifiers.

npc_dota_hero_clinkz.name: Burning Army
npc_dota_hero_clinkz.description: Summons a row of Burning Skeleton Archers in the target location.

npc_dota_hero_clinkz.name: Skeleton Walk
npc_dota_hero_clinkz.description:
Clinkz moves invisibly through units until the moment he attacks or uses items. Leaving Skeleton Walk creates Skeleton Archers.

Skeleton Archers are immobile and die within multiple attacks from a hero or tower. Skeleton Archers deal a percentage of Clinkz' damage, and deal 75% less damage to buildings. Attack range is equal to Clinkz' attack range.

npc_dota_hero_clinkz.name: Infernal Shred
npc_dota_hero_clinkz.description:
Clinkz and his skeletons apply a stacking debuff that causes their attacks to pierce up to 20% of the target's total physical armor (does not reduce their armor). Clinkz applies 3% per attack, and skeletons apply 1%. 

Lasts 5 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_omniknight.name: Purification
npc_dota_hero_omniknight.description: Instantly heals a friendly unit and damages all nearby enemy units.

npc_dota_hero_omniknight.name: Repel
npc_dota_hero_omniknight.description: Grants Debuff Immunity with 60% magic resistance, as well as bonus HP Regen.

npc_dota_hero_omniknight.name: Hammer of Purity
npc_dota_hero_omniknight.description:
Omniknight imbues his hammer with holy power, causing his attack to have increased range, deal pure damage based on a percentage of his base damage and slow his target for a short duration.

 Omniknight heals for 30% of the damage dealt over 5s.

npc_dota_hero_omniknight.name: Degen Aura
npc_dota_hero_omniknight.description: Degenerates the movement capabilities of enemy units that stray too near, slowing their movement speed.

npc_dota_hero_omniknight.name: Guardian Angel
npc_dota_hero_omniknight.description: Omniknight calls upon a Guardian Angel that grants immunity from physical damage to all allied units near Omniknight.

npc_dota_hero_enchantress.name: Impetus
