npc_dota_hero_enchantress.description: Places an enchantment on each attack while activated, causing it to deal additional damage based on how far away the target is. The farther the target, the greater the damage dealt. Deals double damage to illusions.

npc_dota_hero_enchantress.name: Enchant
npc_dota_hero_enchantress.description:
Enchantress charms an enemy. If the enemy is a hero, they are dispelled and slowed for 3.5s, and Enchantress and her units gain bonus attack range against the target.

 If the enemy is a creep, she brings it under her control and receives 40% of their experience bounty. Enchantress can control creeps for up to 30s. 

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

npc_dota_hero_enchantress.name: Nature's Attendants
npc_dota_hero_enchantress.description: A cloud of wisps heals Enchantress and any friendly units nearby.

npc_dota_hero_enchantress.name: Sproink
npc_dota_hero_enchantress.description: Leaps backward, dodges incoming projectiles, and launches an Impetus attack on the 2 furthest enemy units within Enchantress' attack range + 100.

npc_dota_hero_enchantress.name: Little Friends
npc_dota_hero_enchantress.description: Enchantress roots an enemy unit. All creeps, ally, enemy and neutral within a radius will gain bonus movement and attack speed and attack the chosen target for 6 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_enchantress.name: Untouchable
npc_dota_hero_enchantress.description: Enchantress beguiles her enemies, slowing their attacks when she is attacked.

npc_dota_hero_enchantress.name: Rabble-Rouser
npc_dota_hero_enchantress.description: Enchantress causes neutral creeps or any unit under her control to deal additional damage to enemy Heroes.

npc_dota_hero_huskar.name: Inner Fire
npc_dota_hero_huskar.description: In a fiery rage, knocks all nearby enemies away from you to a fixed distance, dealing damage and silencing them.

npc_dota_hero_huskar.name: Burning Spear
npc_dota_hero_huskar.description: Huskar sets his spears aflame, dealing damage over time with his regular attack. Multiple attacks will stack additional damage. Each attack drains some of Huskar's health.

npc_dota_hero_huskar.name: Berserker's Blood
npc_dota_hero_huskar.description: Huskar's injuries feed his power, giving increased attack speed, magic resistance and health regen based on missing health. Health regen is a percentage of your strength.

npc_dota_hero_huskar.name: Blood Magic
npc_dota_hero_huskar.description: Huskar does not have mana. Mana costs of items are converted into health costs.Huskar's Health Costs are Magical Damage and can be reduced by Magic Resist.

npc_dota_hero_huskar.name: Life Break
npc_dota_hero_huskar.description:
Huskar draws upon his health to break an enemy's life, leaping at a target to shatter a percentage of that hero's current health and slow both their movement and attack speed. While leaping, Huskar is Debuff Immune with 60% magic resistance.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

npc_dota_hero_night_stalker.name: Void
npc_dota_hero_night_stalker.description: Creates a damaging void that slows an enemy unit and deals damage. At night, Void also mini-stuns, interrupting channeling abilities, and its effects lasts longer.

npc_dota_hero_night_stalker.name: Crippling Fear
npc_dota_hero_night_stalker.description: Night Stalker horrifies all nearby enemies, causing them to become silenced and take damage over time while near him. The effect lasts longer at night.

npc_dota_hero_night_stalker.name: Hunter in the Night
npc_dota_hero_night_stalker.description: Night Stalker is in his element at night, attacking and moving with great swiftness.

npc_dota_hero_night_stalker.name: Dark Ascension
npc_dota_hero_night_stalker.description: Night Stalker smothers the sun and summons instant darkness, so that he might use his powers at their fullest. Night Stalker gains flight and bonus damage during this time. Has unobstructed vision.

npc_dota_hero_broodmother.name: Insatiable Hunger
npc_dota_hero_broodmother.description: A violent lust for vital fluids increases Broodmother's attack damage and gives her and her Spiderlings a vampiric attack.

npc_dota_hero_broodmother.name: Spin Web
npc_dota_hero_broodmother.description:
Spins a large web that grants Broodmother a passive movement speed increase and increases her Turn Rate, while in its vicinity, as well as giving free movement.

Spin Web can be cast from anywhere as long as the new web touches an existing web. Webs never expire, and can be manually destroyed. When the maximum limit of webs is exceeded, the oldest web disappears.

npc_dota_hero_broodmother.name: Incapacitating Bite
npc_dota_hero_broodmother.description: Broodmother's venom cripples enemy units, causing her attacks to slow and giving the affected unit a chance to miss its attacks and extra damage from attacks.

npc_dota_hero_broodmother.name: Spider's Milk
npc_dota_hero_broodmother.description: Whenever Broodmother kills a unit, she and all units under her control in a 600 radius receive a buff for 3s that heals them for a percentage of the victim's health every 0.5 seconds. Healing from creeps is reduced by 40%.

npc_dota_hero_broodmother.name: Spawn Spiderlings
npc_dota_hero_broodmother.description: Broodmother injects her young into an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing them for 4 seconds. The spiderlings will hatch if the target is killed while under this influence.

npc_dota_hero_bounty_hunter.name: Shuriken Toss
npc_dota_hero_bounty_hunter.description: Hurls a deadly shuriken at an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing the target's movement speed. The shuriken will bounce to any Tracked units who are within a 1200 radius of each other.

npc_dota_hero_bounty_hunter.name: Jinada
npc_dota_hero_bounty_hunter.description: Bounty Hunter plans his next hit, dealing bonus damage and stealing some unreliable gold.

npc_dota_hero_bounty_hunter.name: Shadow Walk
npc_dota_hero_bounty_hunter.description: Bounty Hunter becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed and the ability to move through other units until he attacks or casts a spell. If he breaks the invisibility with an attack, that attack will stun the target for a short duration.

npc_dota_hero_bounty_hunter.name: Friendly Shadow
npc_dota_hero_bounty_hunter.description: Applies Shadow Walk and all of its bonuses to the target ally. Allied fade time is 0.5s. Does not break Bounty Hunter's invisibility when cast.

npc_dota_hero_bounty_hunter.name: Big Game Hunter
npc_dota_hero_bounty_hunter.description: Bounty Hunter receives 15% more kill and assist gold if the dying enemy hero is Big Game. An enemy hero is considered Big Game if they are one of the top 3 net worth heroes on the enemy team.

npc_dota_hero_bounty_hunter.name: Track
npc_dota_hero_bounty_hunter.description: Tracks an enemy hero, granting True Sight of the target, increasing the damage they take and providing information on how much gold it is carrying. If the target dies, Bounty Hunter and nearby heroes collect a bonus bounty of gold. Casting Track does not take you out of invisibility.

npc_dota_hero_weaver.name: The Swarm
npc_dota_hero_weaver.description: Weaver launches a swarm of 12 young Weavers that latch on any enemy unit in their path, attacking and reducing armor until it is killed.

npc_dota_hero_weaver.name: Shukuchi
npc_dota_hero_weaver.description: Weaver shifts out of visibility, gaining max movement speed and doing harm to any enemies it passes through.

npc_dota_hero_weaver.name: Geminate Attack
npc_dota_hero_weaver.description: Allows Weaver to dispatch two attacks at once.

npc_dota_hero_weaver.name: Time Lapse
npc_dota_hero_weaver.description:
Weaver warps backward to whatever position it was in five seconds earlier--regaining the HP and mana from that time. No effect on cooldown, gold or experience.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

npc_dota_hero_weaver.name: Threads of Fate
npc_dota_hero_weaver.description: Whenever Weaver deals damage to an enemy hero with an attack or ability, if he remains within 700 range of them for 1.5s, he establishes a Thread of Fate that briefly slows the enemy and ties Weaver and the enemy together. Each established thread of fate grants bonus damage to Weaver.

npc_dota_hero_jakiro.name: Dual Breath
npc_dota_hero_jakiro.description: An icy blast followed by a wave of fire launches out in a path in front of Jakiro. The ice slows enemies, while the fire delivers damage over time.

npc_dota_hero_jakiro.name: Ice Path
npc_dota_hero_jakiro.description: Creates a path of ice that stuns and damages enemies that touch it.

npc_dota_hero_jakiro.name: Liquid Fire
npc_dota_hero_jakiro.description: Jakiro burns his enemies in an area of effect with fire added to his attack, while slowing their attacks. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.

npc_dota_hero_jakiro.name: Liquid Frost
npc_dota_hero_jakiro.description: Jakiro chill his enemies with ice added to his attack, slowing movement for 5 seconds and increasing damage taken from Jakiro's attacks and abilities. This effect does not apply to buildings. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.

npc_dota_hero_jakiro.name: Double Trouble
npc_dota_hero_jakiro.description: Jakiro's attacks launch an attack from each head, but deal less damage each.

npc_dota_hero_jakiro.name: Macropyre
npc_dota_hero_jakiro.description: Jakiro exhales a wide line of lasting flames, which deals damage per second to any enemy units caught in the fire.

npc_dota_hero_batrider.name: Sticky Napalm
npc_dota_hero_batrider.description: Drenches an area in sticky oil, amplifying damage from Batrider's attacks and abilities and slowing the movement speed and turn rate of enemies. Additional casts of Sticky Napalm continue to increase damage, up to 20 stacks. Applies a small amount of damage with each cast.

npc_dota_hero_batrider.name: Flamebreak
npc_dota_hero_batrider.description: Hurls an explosive cocktail that explodes when it reaches the target location, knocking back, slowing and dealing damage over time to enemies in the area.

npc_dota_hero_batrider.name: Firefly
npc_dota_hero_batrider.description: Batrider takes to the skies, moving increasingly fast and laying down a trail of flames from the air. The fire damages any enemies it touches and destroys trees below Batrider. Maximum movement speed bonus is reached at the end of Firefly's duration.

npc_dota_hero_batrider.name: Smoldering Resin
npc_dota_hero_batrider.description: Batrider's attacks apply a debuff that deals 20% of the attack damage every 1s for 2s.

npc_dota_hero_batrider.name: Flaming Lasso
npc_dota_hero_batrider.description: Lassoes an enemy and drags them in Batrider's wake. Dragged units cannot move, attack, or use abilities. Teleporting or blinking will break the lasso.

npc_dota_hero_chen.name: Penitence
npc_dota_hero_chen.description: Damages enemy unit, forces it to move slower and lets allies attack it more quickly.

npc_dota_hero_chen.name: Holy Persuasion
npc_dota_hero_chen.description: Chen takes control of an enemy or neutral creep and receives a percentage of its bounty. Its maximum health is set to 400. Converted creeps will have increased movement speed and bonus damage. Chen may globally target his own creep if it has not taken damage in the last 3 seconds to unsummon it.

npc_dota_hero_chen.name: Divine Favor
npc_dota_hero_chen.description:
Passively provides an aura that grants increased health regeneration. Can be cast on allies to provide them with bonus armor and increasing the healing and health regeneration they receive.

If cast on Chen, all units controlled by Chen receive the buff.

npc_dota_hero_chen.name: Hand of God
npc_dota_hero_chen.description: Heals all allied heroes on the map as well as all units under Chen's control. A large heal is applied at first and a slow heal over time is applied for 10 seconds afterwards.

npc_dota_hero_spectre.name: Spectral Dagger
npc_dota_hero_spectre.description: Spectre flings a dagger to draw a Shadow Path, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed of any enemies along the trail. Units hit by the dagger also trail a Shadow Path. While treading the path, Spectre moves faster and phases through otherwise impassable terrain.

npc_dota_hero_spectre.name: Shadow Step
npc_dota_hero_spectre.description:
Sends an uncontrollable illusion at a target that follows and attacks the target.

The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.

npc_dota_hero_spectre.name: Dispersion
npc_dota_hero_spectre.description: Spectre disperses part of the damage dealt to her, reflecting it to all nearby enemies. The effect lessens with distance.

npc_dota_hero_spectre.name: Reality
npc_dota_hero_spectre.description: Spectre assumes the target Shadow Step or Haunt illusion, destroying it.

npc_dota_hero_spectre.name: Desolate
npc_dota_hero_spectre.description: Spectre and her illusions deal bonus Pure damage if attacking an enemy that does not have any allied units within a 350 radius around them.

npc_dota_hero_spectre.name: Haunt
npc_dota_hero_spectre.description:
Creates a spectral nemesis to haunt all enemy Heroes.

Haunt illusions are uncontrollable, take extra damage, and deal less damage than Spectre herself. They ignore terrain.

The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.

npc_dota_hero_doom_bringer.name: Devour
npc_dota_hero_doom_bringer.description: Consumes an enemy or neutral creep, acquiring any special abilities that it possessed. If alt-cast is activated, Doom will not acquire the creep's abilities. Duration is equal to the cooldown.

npc_dota_hero_doom_bringer.name: Scorched Earth
npc_dota_hero_doom_bringer.description: Carpets the nearby earth in flames which damage enemies, while also granting Doom increased movement speed and health regeneration.

npc_dota_hero_doom_bringer.name: Infernal Blade
npc_dota_hero_doom_bringer.description: Doom swings his burning sword, igniting the enemy. Stuns for 0.66 seconds and applies a 4 second burn that deals a base damage plus a percentage of the target's Max HP as damage per second.

npc_dota_hero_doom_bringer.name: Devoured Ability
npc_dota_hero_doom_bringer.description: This slot will be replaced with abilities acquired using Devour.

npc_dota_hero_doom_bringer.name: Devoured Ability
npc_dota_hero_doom_bringer.description: This slot will be replaced with abilities acquired using Devour.

npc_dota_hero_doom_bringer.name: Doom
npc_dota_hero_doom_bringer.description:
Inflicts a curse that dispels an enemy and prevents them from casting spells or healing in any way, while taking damage over time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

npc_dota_hero_doom_bringer.name: Lvl ? Pain
npc_dota_hero_doom_bringer.description: Doom's attacks curse enemy heroes. After 2.5s, the cursed hero bursts with a pillar of fire, damaging itself and all units in a 66 AoE for 15% of the damage taken from Doom during the curse. The damage and radius of the curse is 66% stronger if the enemy's level is a multiple of 6.

npc_dota_hero_ancient_apparition.name: Cold Feet
npc_dota_hero_ancient_apparition.description: Places a curse on an enemy, dealing damage over time. If the enemy unit doesn't move outside of the given range from the initial location, it will be stunned and frozen in place after 4 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_ancient_apparition.name: Ice Vortex
npc_dota_hero_ancient_apparition.description: Creates a vortex of icy energy that slows, deals damage, and increases magic damage done to enemies in its range.

npc_dota_hero_ancient_apparition.name: Chilling Touch
npc_dota_hero_ancient_apparition.description: Enhances Ancient Apparition's attack with increased range and a burst of magical damage and slow.

npc_dota_hero_ancient_apparition.name: Bone Chill
npc_dota_hero_ancient_apparition.description: When Ancient Apparition deals Magic damage to an enemy with his abilities, it is slowed for a short duration. If the target is a Hero, its Strength is also reduced. Multiple instances of this effect stack and have independent durations.

npc_dota_hero_ancient_apparition.name: Ice Blast
npc_dota_hero_ancient_apparition.description: Launches a tracer toward any location on the battlefield, which must be triggered again to mark the area to be blasted by a damaging explosion of hail. The further the tracer travels, the larger the explosion will be. Enemies caught in the explosion, or who touch the icy ball of hail as it travels, are Frostbitten, taking damage over time and prevented from regenerating or healing. If a Frostbitten unit's health drops below a certain percentage, they will instantly shatter.

npc_dota_hero_ancient_apparition.name: Release
npc_dota_hero_ancient_apparition.description: Releases the ice blast to explode at the tracer's current location. Can be cast while silenced.

npc_dota_hero_ursa.name: Earthshock
npc_dota_hero_ursa.description: Ursa leaps forward 250 units and slams the earth, causing a powerful shock to damage and slow all enemy units in a nearby area for 4 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_ursa.name: Overpower
npc_dota_hero_ursa.description: Using his skill in combat, Ursa gains increased attack speed and slow resistance for a number of subsequent attacks.

npc_dota_hero_ursa.name: Fury Swipes
npc_dota_hero_ursa.description: Ursa's claws dig deeper wounds in the enemy, causing consecutive attacks to the same enemy to deal more damage. If the same target is not attacked after 8 seconds, the bonus damage is lost.

npc_dota_hero_ursa.name: Maul
npc_dota_hero_ursa.description: Ursa gains bonus damage equal to a percentage of his Current HP.

npc_dota_hero_ursa.name: Enrage
npc_dota_hero_ursa.description:
Ursa goes into a frenzy, providing damage reduction and status resistance. Removes any existing debuffs.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

npc_dota_hero_spirit_breaker.name: Charge of Darkness
npc_dota_hero_spirit_breaker.description:
Spirit Breaker fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging through all objects, starting at 25% of the bonus speed and reaching his max speed after 1.5s.

All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash. If the targeted unit dies, Spirit Breaker will change his target to the nearest enemy unit to that location.

npc_dota_hero_spirit_breaker.name: Bulldoze
npc_dota_hero_spirit_breaker.description: Spirit Breaker gains movement speed and status resistance to ram through enemies. Can be used while charging.

npc_dota_hero_spirit_breaker.name: Greater Bash
npc_dota_hero_spirit_breaker.description: Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack. Deals a percentage of movement speed as damage.

npc_dota_hero_spirit_breaker.name: Planar Pocket
npc_dota_hero_spirit_breaker.description: Barathrum gains magic resistance and distorts reality around the selected hero, making any unit-targeted spells cast by enemy heroes get redirected towards Spirit Breaker. Can be cast on both allied and enemy heroes, but only spells cast by enemies of Spirit Breaker will be redirected.

npc_dota_hero_spirit_breaker.name: Empowering Haste
npc_dota_hero_spirit_breaker.description: Spirit Breaker gains bonus Movement Speed for a duration whenever he stuns an enemy. Effects from multiple stuns stack and have independent durations. Duration pauses during Charge of Darkness.

npc_dota_hero_spirit_breaker.name: Nether Strike
npc_dota_hero_spirit_breaker.description: Spirit Breaker slips into the nether realm, reappearing next to his hapless victim. Upon reappearing, a Greater Bash of the current level occurs and deals bonus damage. Knocks back for double the normal distance.

npc_dota_hero_gyrocopter.name: Rocket Barrage
npc_dota_hero_gyrocopter.description: Launches a salvo of rockets at nearby enemy units in a radius around the Gyrocopter. Lasts 3 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_gyrocopter.name: Homing Missile
npc_dota_hero_gyrocopter.description: Fires a homing missile to seek the targeted enemy unit. The missile gains speed over time, dealing damage and stunning when it impacts the target. Enemy units can destroy the missile before it reaches its target.

npc_dota_hero_gyrocopter.name: Flak Cannon
npc_dota_hero_gyrocopter.description: Gyrocopter's attacks hit all enemy units in an area around it for a limited number of attacks. Only the main target of attacks will receive attack bonuses such as Critical Strike. Lasts 12 seconds or until the attacks are used.

npc_dota_hero_gyrocopter.name: Afterburner
npc_dota_hero_gyrocopter.description: Gyrocopter gains movement speed for a short duration after damaging an enemy with his attacks or abilities.

npc_dota_hero_gyrocopter.name: Call Down
npc_dota_hero_gyrocopter.description: Call down 3 aerial missile strikes that slow and damage enemy units in a target area. Each strike is 500 distance from the previous one.

npc_dota_hero_alchemist.name: Acid Spray
npc_dota_hero_alchemist.description: Sprays high-pressure acid across a target area. Enemy units who step across the contaminated terrain take damage per second and have their armor reduced.

npc_dota_hero_alchemist.name: Unstable Concoction
npc_dota_hero_alchemist.description: Alchemist brews up an unstable concoction that he can throw at an enemy hero, to stun and deal damage in an area around the explosion. The longer the concoction brews, the more damage it deals and the longer the stun. Alchemist is faster while charging the concoction. After 5 seconds, the brew reaches its maximum damage and stun time. However, after 5.5 seconds, the concoction will explode on Alchemist himself if not thrown.

npc_dota_hero_alchemist.name: Corrosive Weaponry
npc_dota_hero_alchemist.description:
Alchemist coats his weapons and empowers his spells with an acid that applies a stacking slow and base attack damage reduction to enemies hit.

Attacks apply 2 stacks. Unstable Concoction applies 1 stack per second of brew time.

npc_dota_hero_alchemist.name: Berserk Potion
npc_dota_hero_alchemist.description:
Alchemist throws a potion at an ally, applying a basic dispel and giving them attack speed, movement speed and HP regen.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

npc_dota_hero_alchemist.name: Greevil's Greed
npc_dota_hero_alchemist.description: Alchemist synthesizes additional gold from his enemies and bounty runes. With each kill, Alchemist earns base bonus gold and extra bonus gold. If Alchemist kills another unit which yields gold within the next 40 seconds, an additional instance of Extra Bonus Gold is added to the total. Additionally, causes bounty runes to yield more gold.

npc_dota_hero_alchemist.name: Chemical Rage
npc_dota_hero_alchemist.description:
Alchemist causes his Ogre to enter a chemically induced rage, reducing base attack cooldown and increasing movement speed and health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

npc_dota_hero_alchemist.name: Unstable Concoction Throw
npc_dota_hero_alchemist.description: Throw it before it blows up!

npc_dota_hero_invoker.name: Quas
npc_dota_hero_invoker.description: Allows manipulation of ice elements. Active Quas instances imbue Invoker with bonus hp regeneration. Passively grants bonus strength per level of Quas.

npc_dota_hero_invoker.name: Wex
npc_dota_hero_invoker.description: Allows manipulation of storm elements. Active Wex instances imbue Invoker with bonus movement and attack speed. Passively grants bonus agility per level of Wex.

npc_dota_hero_invoker.name: Exort
npc_dota_hero_invoker.description: Allows manipulation of fire elements. Active Exort instances imbue Invoker with bonus attack damage. Passively grants bonus intelligence per level of Exort.

npc_dota_hero_invoker.name: Invoked Spell
npc_dota_hero_invoker.description: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active Quas, Wex, and Exort buffs.

npc_dota_hero_invoker.name: Invoked Spell
npc_dota_hero_invoker.description: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active Quas, Wex, and Exort buffs.

npc_dota_hero_invoker.name: Invoke
npc_dota_hero_invoker.description:
Combines the properties of the elements currently being manipulated to create a new spell for Invoker to use. Invoke cooldown is reduced by 0.3 seconds for each orb level.

Invoker's vast knowledge of magic allows him to choose from Multiple Aghanim's Scepter and Shard options. The items must be activated before they can be used, and cannot be changed after they are chosen.

 Click the help button to see the list of possible spells.

npc_dota_hero_invoker.name: Cold Snap
npc_dota_hero_invoker.description: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration based on the level of Quas. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases based on the level of Quas.

npc_dota_hero_invoker.name: Ghost Walk
npc_dota_hero_invoker.description: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible and gaining health and mana regen. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas, and slows Invoker as well based on the level of Wex.

npc_dota_hero_invoker.name: Tornado
npc_dota_hero_invoker.description:
Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level of Wex. Holds enemies in the air for a duration based on the level of Quas. Deals base damage plus added damage based on levels in Wex.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

npc_dota_hero_invoker.name: E.M.P.
npc_dota_hero_invoker.description: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after 2.9 seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana based on the level of Wex. Deals damage for each point of mana drained. If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains 25% of the mana drained.

npc_dota_hero_invoker.name: Alacrity
npc_dota_hero_invoker.description: Invoker infuses an ally with an immense surge of energy, increasing their attack speed based on the level of Wex and their damage based on the level of Exort.

npc_dota_hero_invoker.name: Chaos Meteor
npc_dota_hero_invoker.description: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage based on the level of Exort, and rolling further based on the level of Wex. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time, receiving additional damage based on the level of Exort.

npc_dota_hero_invoker.name: Sun Strike
npc_dota_hero_invoker.description: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Deals damage based on the level of Exort, however this damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.

npc_dota_hero_invoker.name: Forge Spirit
npc_dota_hero_invoker.description: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. Damage and armor are based on the level of Exort while attack range, health, and duration are based on the level of Quas. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes. The number of spirits spawned is determined by the lower level of Quas and Exort.

npc_dota_hero_invoker.name: Ice Wall
npc_dota_hero_invoker.description: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration based on the level of Quas. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas and deals damage each second based on the level of Exort.

npc_dota_hero_invoker.name: Deafening Blast
npc_dota_hero_invoker.description: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with based on the level of Exort. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration based on the level of Quas, then disarm their attacks for a duration based on the level of Wex.

npc_dota_hero_silencer.name: Arcane Curse
npc_dota_hero_silencer.description:
Curses the target area, dealing damage and causing enemies to take damage over time and slowing their movement speed.

Anytime affected enemies cast a spell, the duration is increased. The duration is paused as long as the target is silenced.

npc_dota_hero_silencer.name: Glaives of Wisdom
npc_dota_hero_silencer.description: Silencer enchants his glaives with his wisdom, stealing his target's Intelligence with each hit and dealing additional damage based on his Intelligence.

npc_dota_hero_silencer.name: Last Word
npc_dota_hero_silencer.description: Enchants a target, providing vision of them and causing them to be damaged and silenced if they cast a spell or if the enchantment timer expires. Deals extra damage based on the difference in intelligence between Silencer and the target.

npc_dota_hero_silencer.name: Suffer In Silence
npc_dota_hero_silencer.description:
Silencer takes less damage from and deals more damage to silenced targets.

If an enemy Hero dies within 925 range of Silencer or was debuffed by Silencer at the time of death, Silencer permanently steals 1 Intelligence from them. If the victim was silenced, steal an extra 1 Intelligence.

npc_dota_hero_silencer.name: Global Silence
npc_dota_hero_silencer.description: Silencer stops all sound, preventing enemy heroes and units on the map from casting spells.

npc_dota_hero_silencer.name: Suffer In Silence
npc_dota_hero_silencer.description: Silencer takes less damage from and deals more damage to silenced targets.

npc_dota_hero_obsidian_destroyer.name: Arcane Orb
npc_dota_hero_obsidian_destroyer.description: Adds extra pure damage to Outworld Destroyer's attacks, based on his remaining mana pool.

npc_dota_hero_obsidian_destroyer.name: Astral Imprisonment
npc_dota_hero_obsidian_destroyer.description: Steals a percentage of the target's max mana and places them into an astral prison. The hidden unit is invulnerable and disabled. When the astral prison implodes, it deals damage to the target.

npc_dota_hero_obsidian_destroyer.name: Objurgation
npc_dota_hero_obsidian_destroyer.description: Increases Outworld Destroyer's maximum mana. When cast, protects Outworld Destroyer with an all damage barrier equal to a flat amount and a percentage of his maximum mana.

npc_dota_hero_obsidian_destroyer.name: Essence Flux
npc_dota_hero_obsidian_destroyer.description: Passively grants a chance to restore a percentage of your max mana each time you cast an ability. Restores less mana from spells that modify attacks.

npc_dota_hero_obsidian_destroyer.name: Sanity's Eclipse
npc_dota_hero_obsidian_destroyer.description: Unleashes a psychic blast that deals damage to enemies based on the difference between your mana and the target's mana. Sanity's Eclipse can hit units trapped by Astral Imprisonment.

npc_dota_hero_lycan.name: Summon Wolves
npc_dota_hero_lycan.description: Summons 2 wolves to aid Lycan in battle. At level 3, wolves gain Permanent Invisibility, and at level 4 wolves gain Cripple that gives 20% chance to cripple the target, causing 8 damage per second and lose 60 attack speed for 4 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_lycan.name: Howl
npc_dota_hero_lycan.description: Strikes fear into enemies, reducing armor and attack damage of all enemies within 2000 range of Lycan and his wolves. At night, Howl's armor and attack damage reductions are global.

npc_dota_hero_lycan.name: Feral Impulse
npc_dota_hero_lycan.description: Increases the HP regeneration and damage of Lycan and all units under his control.

npc_dota_hero_lycan.name: Wolf Bite
npc_dota_hero_lycan.description: Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. Lycan and the bitten target gain 40% Lifesteal and share the healing effect of Lifesteal with each other as long as they are within 1200 range of each other.

npc_dota_hero_lycan.name: Apex Predator
npc_dota_hero_lycan.description: Lycan and units he controls deal extra damage to neutral creeps.

npc_dota_hero_lycan.name: Shapeshift
npc_dota_hero_lycan.description: Lycan assumes his lupine form, granting him critical strikes and added vision at night. During Shapeshift, Lycan moves at increased speed and cannot be slowed. Movement and critical strike bonuses are also applied to all units under Lycan's control.

npc_dota_hero_brewmaster.name: Thunder Clap
npc_dota_hero_brewmaster.description: Slams the ground, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed and attack rate of nearby enemy units.

npc_dota_hero_brewmaster.name: Cinder Brew
npc_dota_hero_brewmaster.description:
Rolls a barrel of ale at enemies that damages enemies along its path and spills out at the target location.

Any enemy in the path or the spill area is drenched in cinder brew, becoming slowed. If the enemy receives Magic or Pure damage, they will be ignited, extending the duration by 3s and causing them to take damage over time.

npc_dota_hero_brewmaster.name: Drunken Brawler
npc_dota_hero_brewmaster.description:
Brewmaster can switch stances based on the elements he controls.

Whenever Brewmaster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up, increasing his stance power by 150% for 5s. If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended by 2s. After Brewed Up expires, he is hungover and cannot Brew Up again for 9s.

Earth Brawler gains bonus Magic Resistance and Armor.

Storm Brawler gains bonus Evasion and Movement Speed.

Fire Brawler gains bonus Attack Speed and chance to critical strike.

npc_dota_hero_brewmaster.name: Liquid Courage
npc_dota_hero_brewmaster.description: When Brewmaster drops below 50% Health he gains a Status Resistance buff and his movement speed alternates every 1s between being faster and being slower. The effect becomes stronger at lower health, scaling from 0 up to max values at 20% Health.

npc_dota_hero_brewmaster.name: Primal Split
npc_dota_hero_brewmaster.description: Splits Brewmaster into elements, forming 3 specialized warriors, adept at survival, each with their own abilities. If any of them survive until the end of their summoned timer, the Brewmaster is reborn. Each Warrior gains its respective Drunken Brawler stance.

npc_dota_hero_shadow_demon.name: Disruption
npc_dota_hero_shadow_demon.description: Banishes the targeted unit from the battlefield for a short duration. Upon returning, two illusions of the banished unit with bonus base damage are created under Shadow Demon's control.

npc_dota_hero_shadow_demon.name: Disseminate
npc_dota_hero_shadow_demon.description: Whenever the target takes damage, all enemies, including the target itself if it is an enemy, within 675 range of the target also receive a portion of that damage. Can target enemy and allied units. Effect is paused if the target is hidden by Disruption.

npc_dota_hero_shadow_demon.name: Shadow Poison
npc_dota_hero_shadow_demon.description: Deals damage in a line, and afflicts enemy units with a poison effect. The poison deals 1/2/4/8/16 times the stack damage based on the number of stacks on the target, up to 5 stacks. Additional stacks cause 50 damage each. This deferred damage is dealt when Shadow Poison's duration is expired, or the Release sub-ability is used.

npc_dota_hero_shadow_demon.name: Shadow Poison Release
npc_dota_hero_shadow_demon.description: Releases the poison to do damage on all affected enemies. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Shadow Poison.

npc_dota_hero_shadow_demon.name: Demonic Cleanse
npc_dota_hero_shadow_demon.description:
Cleanses the target allied unit, removing negative buffs for the duration. At the end of the duration, the unit is healed. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Cleanse.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

npc_dota_hero_shadow_demon.name: Demonic Purge
npc_dota_hero_shadow_demon.description:
Purges the target enemy unit, removing positive buffs, and slowing the target for the duration. The unit slowly regains its speed until the end of the duration, upon which damage is dealt. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Purge.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

npc_dota_hero_shadow_demon.name: Menace
npc_dota_hero_shadow_demon.description: Shadow Demon's Attacks apply a stacking debuff to the enemy for 8 seconds that increases their damage taken.

npc_dota_hero_lone_druid.name: Entangle
npc_dota_hero_lone_druid.description:
Allows Lone Druid to Entangle enemies once they gain 5 stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.

When cast, applies 2 stacks to each enemy hero in the area and 5 stacks to enemy creeps. Also empowers Lone Druid for 10s, making him apply 1 stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.

Leveling this ability also levels Spirit Bear's Entangling Claws ability.

npc_dota_hero_lone_druid.name: Spirit Link
npc_dota_hero_lone_druid.description: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.

npc_dota_hero_lone_druid.name: Savage Roar
npc_dota_hero_lone_druid.description: Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear roar fiercely causing nearby enemies to flee towards their base in terror. Their movement speed is increased by 20%.

npc_dota_hero_lone_druid.name: Summon Spirit Bear
npc_dota_hero_lone_druid.description:
Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion that can equip items.

If the bear moves 1100 distance away from the Lone Druid, it cannot attack. Lone Druid suffers 20% of his max health as backlash damage if the Spirit Bear dies.
Spirit Bear has Demolish, Return, Entangling Claws, Savage Roar, and Spirit Link abilities.

npc_dota_hero_lone_druid.name: True Form
npc_dota_hero_lone_druid.description: Lone Druid morphs himself into a raging bear, losing his ranged advantage, but gaining bonus armor, bonus health, and bonus attack damage.

npc_dota_hero_chaos_knight.name: Chaos Bolt
npc_dota_hero_chaos_knight.description: Throws a mysterious bolt of energy at the target unit. It stuns for a random duration and deals random damage.

npc_dota_hero_chaos_knight.name: Reality Rift
npc_dota_hero_chaos_knight.description: Teleports Chaos Knight, any illusions he has, and the target unit to a point along the line between him and the target. The enemy unit has their armor reduced for 6s.

npc_dota_hero_chaos_knight.name: Chaos Strike
npc_dota_hero_chaos_knight.description: Chaos Knight and his illusions' attacks have a chance to deal a critical strike of varying strength with bonus lifesteal. Lifesteal from creeps is reduced.

npc_dota_hero_chaos_knight.name: Phantasm
npc_dota_hero_chaos_knight.description:
Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions. The phantasms are illusions that deal 100% damage, but take 350% damage.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

npc_dota_hero_meepo.name: Earthbind
npc_dota_hero_meepo.description: Tosses a net at the target point, rooting down all enemy units in an area around it.

npc_dota_hero_meepo.name: Poof
npc_dota_hero_meepo.description:
Drawing mystical energies from the earth, a Meepo can teleport to another Meepo or itself after channeling for 1.5 seconds, damaging the enemy in both the departure and arrival locations. 

If the ability is in alt-cast state, all Meepos will also cast Poof to the target. When cast on the ground, all Meepos except the selected one will Poof to the closest location.

npc_dota_hero_meepo.name: Ransack
npc_dota_hero_meepo.description:
Steals health from the enemy with each strike and heals all other Meepos for that amount.

Reduced to 60% against creeps.

npc_dota_hero_meepo.name: Dig
npc_dota_hero_meepo.description:
Digs into the ground for a short duration, dispelling Meepo and causing him to become invulnerable and untargetable for 3s. Restores 25% of his max health over that duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

npc_dota_hero_meepo.name: MegaMeepo
npc_dota_hero_meepo.description:
Primary Meepo mounts all other Meepos in a 600 radius around him on top of his shoulders. While in this form, he gains 40% of the other Meepo stats and can Fling them at enemies, dealing damage and slowing them.

 When cast, Earthbind generates additional nets and Poof deals 50% more damage for each Meepo on top.

npc_dota_hero_meepo.name: Divided We Stand
npc_dota_hero_meepo.description:
Meepo summons another Meepo, which levels up and shares items with the main Meepo. Ability cooldowns are independent, but items share cooldowns between Meepos. Damage, attack speed, health / mana regeneration, mana burn, and proc chance bonuses from items are distributed equally among the amount of Meepos.

If any Meepo dies, they all die.

npc_dota_hero_meepo.name: Geomancy
npc_dota_hero_meepo.description:
Meepo grants stacking bonuses to himself and his clones based on their terrain. Each Meepo grants his bonus to the other Meepos.

If there is a tree within 250 range, he receives 1 HP regen.

If he is standing on dirt, he receives 2% bonus movement speed.

If he is in the water, his attacks slow the target by 2% for 2 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_treant.name: Nature's Grasp
npc_dota_hero_treant.description: Creates vines towards the target location. Vines slow down and deal damage to enemies that walk through. Does 35% less damage to creeps.

npc_dota_hero_treant.name: Leech Seed
npc_dota_hero_treant.description: Treant's attack plants a life-sapping seed in an enemy unit. That unit takes additional magic damage, is rooted and disarmed for a short duration, and emits 2 healing pulses to up to 5 nearby allies of Treant Protector based on the damage dealt by the attack.

npc_dota_hero_treant.name: Living Armor
npc_dota_hero_treant.description: Infuses the target hero or structure with a protective coating which heals the target and blocks damage from player-controlled sources. Each time this spell blocks damage, the block amount is decreased. If the damage block is decreased to 0, the buff is removed early.

npc_dota_hero_treant.name: Eyes In The Forest
npc_dota_hero_treant.description: Treant Protector enchants a tree, which grants him unobstructed vision in that location. The eyes last for 360 seconds and are invisible, but are destroyed if their host tree is destroyed or if they are attacked directly.

npc_dota_hero_treant.name: Nature's Guise
npc_dota_hero_treant.description: Grants bonus movement speed when near trees. Treant Protector additionally has Tree Walking if he has not taken damage for 2.75 seconds. While Tree Walking, Nature's Guise can be activated to grant Treant invisibility until he attacks or is no longer near a tree.

npc_dota_hero_treant.name: Overgrowth
npc_dota_hero_treant.description: Summons an overgrowth of vines and branches around Treant that deal damage to afflicted enemies and prevent them from moving, blinking, going invisible, or attacking.

npc_dota_hero_ogre_magi.name: Fireblast
npc_dota_hero_ogre_magi.description: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing damage and stunning the target.

npc_dota_hero_ogre_magi.name: Ignite
npc_dota_hero_ogre_magi.description: Drenches the target and another random unit in volatile chemicals, causing it to burst into flames. The target is in immense pain, taking damage and moving more slowly.

npc_dota_hero_ogre_magi.name: Bloodlust
npc_dota_hero_ogre_magi.description: Incites a frenzy in a friendly unit, increasing its movement speed and attack speed. Gives bonus attack speed if cast on Ogre himself. Can be cast on towers.

npc_dota_hero_ogre_magi.name: Unrefined Fireblast
npc_dota_hero_ogre_magi.description: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing 150 + 1.5x Ogre's Strength in damage and stunning the target. Its mana cost is 35% of Ogre Magi's current mana.

npc_dota_hero_ogre_magi.name: Fire Shield
npc_dota_hero_ogre_magi.description: Creates a shield around the target ally, absorbing a percentage of the damage of next 3 attacks from enemy heroes. When damage is absorbed, a fireball is launched at the attacker. Can be cast on towers.

npc_dota_hero_ogre_magi.name: Multicast
npc_dota_hero_ogre_magi.description: Enables Ogre Magi to cast his abilities and items multiple times with each use. Each point of Strength adds to Multicast chance. Every 16 Strength adds 1%.

npc_dota_hero_undying.name: Decay
npc_dota_hero_undying.description: Undying steals strength from all enemy heroes in an area, dealing base damage as he claims the enemy's strength for himself. Deals 2x damage to creeps.

npc_dota_hero_undying.name: Soul Rip
npc_dota_hero_undying.description: Undying rips health away from all nearby units and uses it to heal an ally, or damage an enemy. Soul Rip can also be used to heal Tombstone.

npc_dota_hero_undying.name: Tombstone
npc_dota_hero_undying.description: Summons a tombstone at the target point. Zombies will frequently spawn next to every enemy unit in the area around the Tombstone, and attack them. Zombies have the Deathlust ability, which causes their attacks to slow the target, and if the target reaches below a certain amount of health, increases the attack and movement speed of the zombie.

npc_dota_hero_undying.name: Flesh Golem
npc_dota_hero_undying.description: Undying transforms into a horrifying flesh golem. While in this state, he gains a percentage increase to strength, bonus movement speed, and causes attacks to slow, apply damage amplification, and spawn Tombstone zombies.

npc_dota_hero_rubick.name: Telekinesis
npc_dota_hero_rubick.description: Rubick uses his telekinetic powers to lift the enemy into the air briefly and then hurls them back at the ground. The unit lands on the ground with such force that it stuns nearby enemies.

npc_dota_hero_rubick.name: Fade Bolt
npc_dota_hero_rubick.description: Rubick creates a powerful stream of arcane energy that travels between enemy units, dealing damage and reducing their attack and spell damage. Each jump deals less damage.

npc_dota_hero_rubick.name: Arcane Supremacy
npc_dota_hero_rubick.description: Rubick's mastery of the arcane allows him to have a larger cast range and bonus spell amplification.

npc_dota_hero_rubick.name: Stolen Spell
npc_dota_hero_rubick.description: Spells acquired with Spell Steal will replace this slot.

npc_dota_hero_rubick.name: Stolen Spell
npc_dota_hero_rubick.description: Spells acquired with Spell Steal will replace this slot.

npc_dota_hero_rubick.name: Spell Steal
npc_dota_hero_rubick.description: Rubick studies the trace magical essence of one enemy hero, learning the secrets of the last spell the hero cast. Rubick can use this spell as his own for several minutes or until he dies.

npc_dota_hero_rubick.name: Telekinesis Land
npc_dota_hero_rubick.description: Chooses the location the target will land when Telekinesis finishes.

npc_dota_hero_rubick.name: Curiosity
npc_dota_hero_rubick.description:
Rubick gains 1 stack of Curiosity per level that grants him 1 base damage, 0.3% Buff/Debuff Duration, and 2 AOE Bonus. 

If Rubick sees an enemy Hero cast an ability within 1200 distance of him, he gains 2 Curiosity for 20 seconds. If an enemy Hero dies while Rubick has Curiosity from them and he damaged them in the last 3 seconds, he gains 1 Curiosity permanently.

npc_dota_hero_rubick.name: Telekinesis Land
npc_dota_hero_rubick.description: Chooses the location you will land when Telekinesis finishes.

npc_dota_hero_disruptor.name: Thunder Strike
npc_dota_hero_disruptor.description: Repeatedly strikes the targeted unit with lightning. Each strike damages nearby enemy units in a small radius and slows enemy movement and attack speed by 100% for x1.75 seconds. Provides vision of its target.

npc_dota_hero_disruptor.name: Glimpse
npc_dota_hero_disruptor.description: Teleports the target hero back to where it was 4 seconds ago. Instantly kills illusions. Deals damage equal to a percentage of the distance glimpsed, that cannot go over a damage maximum.

npc_dota_hero_disruptor.name: Kinetic Field
npc_dota_hero_disruptor.description: After a short formation time, creates a circular barrier of kinetic energy that enemies can't pass.

npc_dota_hero_disruptor.name: Kinetic Fence
npc_dota_hero_disruptor.description: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.

npc_dota_hero_disruptor.name: Electromagnetic Repulsion
npc_dota_hero_disruptor.description: Whenever Disruptor takes more than 250 damage from any source within 400 radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to 1.5x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a 400 distance away.

npc_dota_hero_disruptor.name: Static Storm
npc_dota_hero_disruptor.description: Creates a damaging static storm that also silences all enemy units in the area for the duration. The damage starts off weak, but increases in power over the duration.

npc_dota_hero_nyx_assassin.name: Impale
npc_dota_hero_nyx_assassin.description: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units take damage, then are hurled into the air and stunned.

npc_dota_hero_nyx_assassin.name: Mind Flare
npc_dota_hero_nyx_assassin.description: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's Max Mana and burns part of it away. Deals additional damage equal to a percentage of the damage the target has taken from Nyx Assassin in the last 15s. Resets accumulated damage before applying damage.

npc_dota_hero_nyx_assassin.name: Spiked Carapace
npc_dota_hero_nyx_assassin.description:
When activated while above ground, Spiked Carapace reflects and negates damage dealt to Nyx Assassin (max once from each source), as well as stunning the source of the damage. Activating Spiked Carapace will not break Vendetta invisibility.

While Burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast.

npc_dota_hero_nyx_assassin.name: Burrow
npc_dota_hero_nyx_assassin.description: Nyx Assassin buries himself beneath the battlefield over a short duration. Once burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast, the range of Mind Flare and Impale is increased, and Impale's cooldown is decreased. While burrowed, Nyx Assassin is stationary, unable to attack, and invisible. Nyx Assassin gains damage reduction from all damage sources.

npc_dota_hero_nyx_assassin.name: Mana Burn
npc_dota_hero_nyx_assassin.description: Nyx Assassin's damage on enemies also burns mana as a percentage of the damage dealt.

npc_dota_hero_nyx_assassin.name: Vendetta
npc_dota_hero_nyx_assassin.description: Nyx Assassin becomes invisible and gains a speed bonus. If Nyx Assassin attacks to break the invisibility, massive bonus damage is dealt with the attack that applies a break to the target. Nyx Assassin has 75 additional attack range and a 70% faster attack animation for this attack.

npc_dota_hero_naga_siren.name: Mirror Image
npc_dota_hero_naga_siren.description:
Creates multiple images of Naga Siren under her control.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

npc_dota_hero_naga_siren.name: Ensnare
npc_dota_hero_naga_siren.description: Interrupts the target and traps them in place, preventing movement or blinking. Can target units affected by Song of the Siren.

npc_dota_hero_naga_siren.name: Rip Tide
npc_dota_hero_naga_siren.description: Naga Siren and her illusions deal bonus damage to enemies and reduce their armor for 4 seconds every 6 attacks.

npc_dota_hero_naga_siren.name: Reel In
npc_dota_hero_naga_siren.description: CHANNELED - Naga Siren channels for up to 5 seconds, pulling all units affected by Naga's Ensnare in a 1600 range towards her at a speed of 200. Channeling ends when the Ensnared unit is 100 distance away.

npc_dota_hero_naga_siren.name: Eelskin
npc_dota_hero_naga_siren.description: Naga Siren has bonus evasion, increased per every other Naga Siren within 900 radius.

npc_dota_hero_naga_siren.name: Song of the Siren
npc_dota_hero_naga_siren.description: All enemies in range of the Naga Siren are put into a magical stasis where they cannot act or be attacked. Using Song of the Siren again will end the duration early.

npc_dota_hero_naga_siren.name: Song of the Siren End
npc_dota_hero_naga_siren.description: Release enemy units from your song so they can be targeted again.

npc_dota_hero_keeper_of_the_light.name: Illuminate
npc_dota_hero_keeper_of_the_light.description: CHANNELED - Channels light energy, building power the longer it's channeled. Once released, a wave is sent forth that deals damage and gives vision in its path. The longer it is channeled, the more damage is dealt.

npc_dota_hero_keeper_of_the_light.name: Blinding Light
npc_dota_hero_keeper_of_the_light.description: A blinding light flashes over the targeted area, knocking back units to the edge of the area and blinding them, causing them to miss some attacks. Minimum knockback distance is 175 range over 0.6 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_keeper_of_the_light.name: Chakra Magic
npc_dota_hero_keeper_of_the_light.description: Restores mana to the target unit and reduces cooldowns of all basic abilities currently on cooldown by a fixed amount. Is 30% more effective when used on himself.

npc_dota_hero_keeper_of_the_light.name: Solar Bind
npc_dota_hero_keeper_of_the_light.description: Weakens an enemy's magical resistance, and applies a slow that increases in strength the more the target moves.

npc_dota_hero_keeper_of_the_light.name: Will-O-Wisp
npc_dota_hero_keeper_of_the_light.description: Summons Ignis Fatuus at the targeted area. Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.

npc_dota_hero_keeper_of_the_light.name: Spirit Form
npc_dota_hero_keeper_of_the_light.description: Ezalor temporarily turns his body luminescent, gaining cast range, increasing the speed bonus from Bright Speed, and allows Illuminate to be channeled by a separate spirit and heal allies.

npc_dota_hero_keeper_of_the_light.name: Bright Speed
npc_dota_hero_keeper_of_the_light.description:
Keeper of the Light gains 1 movement speed for every 2.5 Intelligence.

Whenever Keeper of the Light moves 300 distance, he leaves behind light that allows him to see 400 range for 3 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_wisp.name: Tether
npc_dota_hero_wisp.description: Tethers Io to an allied unit, granting bonus movement speed to both. When Io restores health or mana, the tethered unit gains a portion of that amount. The tether breaks when the allied unit moves too far away, or Io cancels the tether. Tether slows enemies touching it.

npc_dota_hero_wisp.name: Spirits
npc_dota_hero_wisp.description: Summon five particle spirits that dance in a circle around Io. If a particle collides with an enemy hero, it explodes, damaging all enemy units in an area around it. Creeps take minor damage from touching a particle spirit, but do not cause them to explode. When its duration ends, any remaining Spirits explode.

npc_dota_hero_wisp.name: Overcharge
npc_dota_hero_wisp.description: Io gains attack speed, spell amplification, and health regeneration based on max health. If Io is Tethered to an ally, that unit also gains any bonuses granted by Overcharge.

npc_dota_hero_wisp.name: Spirits In
npc_dota_hero_wisp.description: Sends the spirits closer to you. Can be toggled on and off.

npc_dota_hero_wisp.name: Spirits Out
npc_dota_hero_wisp.description: Sends the spirits farther away from you. Can be toggled on and off.

npc_dota_hero_wisp.name: Relocate
npc_dota_hero_wisp.description: Teleports Io and a tethered ally to any location. After the spell expires, Io and the tethered ally will return to their original location. Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.

npc_dota_hero_wisp.name: Break Tether
npc_dota_hero_wisp.description: Break the link to the tethered unit.

npc_dota_hero_wisp.name: Equilibrium
npc_dota_hero_wisp.description: Io gains outgoing damage amplification the closer it is to full health, and Health Restoration and Healing Amplification the closer it is to zero health.

npc_dota_hero_visage.name: Grave Chill
npc_dota_hero_visage.description: Visage drains the movement and attack speed of the targeted unit, gaining the drained speed for itself and nearby Familiars.

npc_dota_hero_visage.name: Soul Assumption
npc_dota_hero_visage.description: Visage gathers charges of soul essence each time nearby heroes take more than 100 damage. When the essence is released, it deals base damage as well as damage for each gathered soul charge.

npc_dota_hero_visage.name: Gravekeeper's Cloak
npc_dota_hero_visage.description:
Visage generates a layered barrier that protects him from damage. If he receives damage from a player, one layer is removed, and takes time to recover.

Visage's Familiars are protected by his cloak when within 900 range of him, based on the number of layers Visage has.

npc_dota_hero_visage.name: Stone Form
npc_dota_hero_visage.description:
Orders the Familiar closest to Visage to cast Stone Form in its current location, turning into stone and smashing into the ground, stunning and damaging all targets in the area. The Familiar becomes invulnerable, and will regain its health very rapidly. After 6 seconds, the Familiar will automatically leave Stone Form.

 Can be alt-cast to order the closest Familiar to the target location to move there and cast Stone Form.

npc_dota_hero_visage.name: Silent as the Grave
npc_dota_hero_visage.description: Visage gains flying movement and bonus movement speed. Upon attacking or casting, the speed and flying movement are lost and Visage and his familiars deal additional attack damage for 2s.

npc_dota_hero_visage.name: Summon Familiars
npc_dota_hero_visage.description:
Conjures 2 blind Familiars to fight for Visage. Familiars possess the Stone Form ability, that allows them to turn into stone, stunning enemies upon landing. While in Stone Form, Familiars are invulnerable, and rapidly regenerate their health. Familiars grant high bounty when killed.

The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after 4s, during which they cannot attack or act.

npc_dota_hero_visage.name: Stone Form
npc_dota_hero_visage.description:
After a short delay, the Familiar turns into stone and smashes into the ground, stunning and damaging all targets in the area. The Familiar becomes invulnerable, and will regain its health very rapidly. After 6 seconds, the Familiar will automatically leave Stone Form. 

 Can be alt-cast to order the Familiar to move to the target location and cast Stone Form.

npc_dota_hero_slark.name: Dark Pact
npc_dota_hero_slark.description:
After a short delay, Slark sacrifices some of his life blood, purging most negative debuffs and dealing damage to enemy units around him and to himself. Slark only takes 30% of the damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

npc_dota_hero_slark.name: Pounce
npc_dota_hero_slark.description: Slark leaps forward, leashing and applying Essence Shift stacks to the first hero he connects. That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.

npc_dota_hero_slark.name: Saltwater Shiv
npc_dota_hero_slark.description:
Slark slices the target with his salty shiv, stealing a portion of the target's movement speed, Health Regen and Health Restoration.

These effects stack independently.

npc_dota_hero_slark.name: Depth Shroud
npc_dota_hero_slark.description: Creates a cloud at the target location. All allies inside the radius are hidden and affected by Shadow Dance.

npc_dota_hero_slark.name: Essence Shift
npc_dota_hero_slark.description: Slark steals the life essence of enemy heroes with his attacks, draining 1 of each of their attributes and converting them to bonus 3 Agility. If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals 1 Agility.

npc_dota_hero_slark.name: Shadow Dance
npc_dota_hero_slark.description:
When not visible to the enemy team, Slark passively gains bonus movement speed and health regeneration. If Slark is damaged by a neutral unit, the passive movement and health regeneration bonuses are lost for 2 seconds.

When activated, Slark hides himself in a cloud of shadows, becoming immune to detection. Attacking, casting spells, and using items will not reveal Slark, but enemies can see the cloud itself.

npc_dota_hero_medusa.name: Split Shot
npc_dota_hero_medusa.description: Medusa magically splits her shot into several arrows. These arrows deal a lower percent of her normal damage.The extra targets will not receive other attack effects (such as critical strike).

npc_dota_hero_medusa.name: Mystic Snake
npc_dota_hero_medusa.description: A mystic snake made of energy jumps from target to target dealing damage. Damage and speed increases with each jump. After it reaches its last target, it returns to Medusa to replenish her with mana. The snake returns a percentage of the targets' total mana.

npc_dota_hero_medusa.name: Gorgon's Grasp
npc_dota_hero_medusa.description: Medusa fires arrows in a line that land in 3 groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second.

npc_dota_hero_medusa.name: Cold Blooded
npc_dota_hero_medusa.description: When Medusa is targeted with a spell, a single-target Mystic Snake is sent back towards the enemy that turns them into stone for 1s.

npc_dota_hero_medusa.name: Mana Shield
npc_dota_hero_medusa.description: Creates a shield that absorbs 98% of incoming damage in exchange for Medusa's mana. Illusions absorb 60% less damage per point of mana.

npc_dota_hero_medusa.name: Stone Gaze
npc_dota_hero_medusa.description: Any enemy units looking at Medusa will have their movement and attack speed slowed. If 2 seconds of total time is accumulated looking at Medusa while Stone Gaze is active, that unit will turn to stone. Petrified units are stunned, and take bonus physical attack damage.

npc_dota_hero_troll_warlord.name: Battle Stance
npc_dota_hero_troll_warlord.description:
Troll Warlord swaps from using ranged to melee attacks. While melee, Troll Warlord's base attack time is improved to 1.4.

Troll Warlord gains 1 armor per 30 bonus attack speed.

npc_dota_hero_troll_warlord.name: Whirling Axes (Ranged)
npc_dota_hero_troll_warlord.description: Troll hurls a fistful of five axes in a cone shape over 950 range, slowing and damaging enemy units.

npc_dota_hero_troll_warlord.name: Whirling Axes (Melee)
npc_dota_hero_troll_warlord.description: Troll hurls two axes around him in a close range area of effect, damaging enemy units and causing them to miss some attacks.

npc_dota_hero_troll_warlord.name: Fervor
npc_dota_hero_troll_warlord.description: With each continuous blow on the same target, Troll gains increased attack speed. If Troll changes targets, the stacks drop to zero.

npc_dota_hero_troll_warlord.name: Berserker's Rage
npc_dota_hero_troll_warlord.description:
While in melee form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to ensnare, preventing the target from moving or using mobility spells and has additional movement speed.

When in ranged form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to Maim the target, dealing bonus damage, and slowing the target's movement and attack speed.

npc_dota_hero_troll_warlord.name: Battle Trance
npc_dota_hero_troll_warlord.description:
Troll unleashes a powerful battle trance, that forces you to continuously attack the closest enemy unit within 900 range, prioritizing heroes. Damage does not kill you during this mode. Grants you bonus lifesteal, attack speed and movement speed. Applies a Basic Dispel.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

npc_dota_hero_centaur.name: Hoof Stomp
npc_dota_hero_centaur.description: After a brief windup, Centaur Warrunner slams the ground, stunning and damaging nearby enemy units. During the delay, he is disarmed but can move.

npc_dota_hero_centaur.name: Double Edge
npc_dota_hero_centaur.description: Centaur strikes a mighty blow at melee range, damaging both himself and a small area around the target. Deals extra damage based on your strength. Centaur cannot die from Double Edge.

npc_dota_hero_centaur.name: Retaliate
npc_dota_hero_centaur.description: Centaur counters all attacks, dealing damage back to the attacker. Returns a fixed amount plus a percentage of your strength. Deals half damage to towers.

npc_dota_hero_centaur.name: Work Horse
npc_dota_hero_centaur.description: Centaur hitches a cart behind him. While active, Centaur gains the benefit of Stampede for the current level of Stampede, and can cast Hitch a Ride on a target ally.

npc_dota_hero_centaur.name: Hitch A Ride
npc_dota_hero_centaur.description: Centaur tosses an ally into a cart hitched behind him. While in the cart, the ally is invulnerable and can still cast and attack normally, but cannot move independently or be targeted by opponents. Increases the attack range of melee heroes by 200.

npc_dota_hero_centaur.name: Stampede
npc_dota_hero_centaur.description: Centaur leads all allies into a vicious charge causing them to move through units at max speed and slow any enemy units they trample. Trampled enemies take damage based on Centaur Warrunner's strength. Each enemy can be trampled once.

npc_dota_hero_centaur.name: Horsepower
npc_dota_hero_centaur.description:
Centaur Warrunner gains 30% of his strength as bonus movement speed.

 This Movement speed bonus does not stack with bonuses from boots.

npc_dota_hero_magnataur.name: Shockwave
npc_dota_hero_magnataur.description: Magnus sends out a wave of force, damaging enemy units in a line, pulling them towards him, and slowing them for a brief period.

npc_dota_hero_magnataur.name: Empower
npc_dota_hero_magnataur.description:
When cast on an ally, grants them bonus damage and cleave on attack. 

 Empower is always on Magnus with 30% larger bonus.

npc_dota_hero_magnataur.name: Skewer
npc_dota_hero_magnataur.description: Magnus rushes forward, goring enemy units on his massive tusk. Heroes hit on the way will be dragged to the destination, then damaged and affected by slowed movement speed. The damage is increased based on distance traveled.

npc_dota_hero_magnataur.name: Horn Toss
npc_dota_hero_magnataur.description: Magnus tosses any enemies in front of him, launching them to his rear. Enemies take damage, spend 0.6 seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.

npc_dota_hero_magnataur.name: Solid Core
npc_dota_hero_magnataur.description: Magnus has increased slow resistance and suffers less knockback from enemy's abilities and items.

npc_dota_hero_shredder.name: Whirling Death
npc_dota_hero_shredder.description: Timbersaw whirls extremely sharp edges, damaging enemies and destroying trees around him in an area. If an enemy hero is affected, it loses some of its primary attribute for a short duration. Whirling Death will deal bonus damage per tree destroyed.

npc_dota_hero_shredder.name: Timber Chain
npc_dota_hero_shredder.description: Timbersaw fires a chain that embeds itself in the first tree it hits, pulling him towards it. Any enemy in the path takes damage.

npc_dota_hero_shredder.name: Reactive Armor
npc_dota_hero_shredder.description: Each time Timbersaw is attacked, he gains increased health regen and armor. Hero attacks are counted as 4x the amount.

npc_dota_hero_shredder.name: Flamethrower
npc_dota_hero_shredder.description: Releases a flame in the direction Timbersaw is facing. Applies a debuff that deals damage per second and slows enemy movement speed. Affects buildings for reduced damage.

npc_dota_hero_shredder.name: Chakram
npc_dota_hero_shredder.description: Fires Timbersaw's main saw blade at the target location where it will spin in place, dealing damage in an area around it. Enemies caught in the saw blade will move more slowly for every 5% of health missing. The blade deals damage and cuts down trees in its path when fired and retracted. While active the ability costs mana, and Timbersaw loses the ability to attack.

npc_dota_hero_shredder.name: Exposure Therapy
npc_dota_hero_shredder.description: Whenever Timbersaw destroys a tree, he gains mana.

npc_dota_hero_bristleback.name: Viscous Nasal Goo
npc_dota_hero_bristleback.description: Covers a target in snot, causing it to have reduced armor and movement speed for 5 seconds. Multiple casts stack and refresh the duration.

npc_dota_hero_bristleback.name: Quill Spray
npc_dota_hero_bristleback.description: Sprays enemy units with quills dealing damage in an area of effect around Bristleback. Deals bonus damage for every time a unit was hit by Quill Spray in the last 14 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_bristleback.name: Bristleback
npc_dota_hero_bristleback.description: Bristleback takes less damage if hit on the sides or rear. If Bristleback takes enough damage from the rear, he releases a Quill Spray of the current level.

npc_dota_hero_bristleback.name: Hairball
npc_dota_hero_bristleback.description: Coughs a quill-packed hairball towards the target location. Erupts at the location, hitting enemies with Viscous Nasal Goo stacks and Quill Spray.

npc_dota_hero_bristleback.name: Warpath
npc_dota_hero_bristleback.description: Bristleback works himself up into a fury every time he casts a spell, increasing his movement speed and damage.

npc_dota_hero_bristleback.name: Prickly
npc_dota_hero_bristleback.description: Bristleback has bonus damage and debuff duration amp against enemy heroes that are behind him.

npc_dota_hero_tusk.name: Ice Shards
npc_dota_hero_tusk.description: Tusk compresses shards of ice into a ball of frozen energy that damages all enemies it comes in contact with. When the ball reaches its target destination the shards are released, creating a barrier that lasts for 4 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_tusk.name: Snowball
npc_dota_hero_tusk.description: Tusk begins rolling into a snowball. Allies within a 325 radius can also be added to the snowball by right-clicking on them, even while the snowball is moving. Once launched, any enemies caught in the snowball's path will be stunned and take damage. Each allied Hero in the snowball will add to its damage and stun duration.

npc_dota_hero_tusk.name: Tag Team
npc_dota_hero_tusk.description: Activate to temporarily apply a negative debuff aura around you, causing enemies that are attacked under it to take bonus physical damage and reduced movement speed. Lasts 6 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_tusk.name: Drinking Buddies
npc_dota_hero_tusk.description: Tusk reaches out to tag an allied unit, pulling them closer. Once tagged, both Tusk and his tagged ally gain movement speed and armor. Can be put on alt-cast to only pull Tusk towards his ally with 50% reduced cast range.

npc_dota_hero_tusk.name: Walrus Kick
npc_dota_hero_tusk.description: Kicks the closest enemy unit in the drawn direction, stunning, damaging, and slowing them. Also deals damage to all heroes within 250 radius of its landing area. Cooldown is reduced by 50% if kicking a creep.

npc_dota_hero_tusk.name: Walrus PUNCH!
npc_dota_hero_tusk.description: Tusk connects with his mighty Walrus Punch, a critical strike with bonus damage so powerful it launches its victim into the air.

npc_dota_hero_tusk.name: Launch Snowball
npc_dota_hero_tusk.description: Launch the snowball toward the target.

npc_dota_hero_tusk.name: Bitter Chill
npc_dota_hero_tusk.description: Passively slows the attack speed of all enemy heroes within a 350 unit radius.

npc_dota_hero_skywrath_mage.name: Arcane Bolt
npc_dota_hero_skywrath_mage.description: Skywrath Mage launches a slow-moving bolt of arcane magic, dealing damage to an enemy unit based on Skywrath Mage's intelligence.

npc_dota_hero_skywrath_mage.name: Concussive Shot
npc_dota_hero_skywrath_mage.description: Skywrath Mage sets off a long range shot that hits the closest hero within a long range. Upon impact, it deals damage and slows in an area of effect.

npc_dota_hero_skywrath_mage.name: Ancient Seal
npc_dota_hero_skywrath_mage.description: Skywrath Mage seals the targeted unit with an ancient rune, silencing it and causing it to take additional damage from spells.

npc_dota_hero_skywrath_mage.name: Shield of the Scion
npc_dota_hero_skywrath_mage.description: Every time Skywrath Mage deals magical damage to an enemy hero with his abilities, he gains a small magic damage barrier. Each buff stacks independently.

npc_dota_hero_skywrath_mage.name: Mystic Flare
npc_dota_hero_skywrath_mage.description: Skywrath Mage uses his ultimate magical ability to conjure a precise and violent mystical field that lays waste to his adversaries. Deals massive damage distributed evenly among any Heroes in the area over 2 seconds.

npc_dota_hero_abaddon.name: Mist Coil
npc_dota_hero_abaddon.description: Abaddon releases a coil of deathly mist that can damage an enemy unit or heal a friendly unit at the cost of some of Abaddon's health.

npc_dota_hero_abaddon.name: Aphotic Shield
npc_dota_hero_abaddon.description:
Summons dark energies around an ally unit, dispelling them and creating an all damage barrier that absorbs a set amount of damage before expiring. When the barrier is destroyed it will burst and deal damage equal to the amount it could absorb to an area around it.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

npc_dota_hero_abaddon.name: Curse of Avernus
npc_dota_hero_abaddon.description: Abaddon strikes an enemy, affecting them by a chilling curse, slowing them, causing them to take damage over time, and all attacks against them gain an attack speed boost. Damage over time component to buildings is reduced by 100%.

npc_dota_hero_abaddon.name: Withering Mist
npc_dota_hero_abaddon.description: Damaging enemies applies the Withering Mist debuff for 5s. Affected enemies have their Health Restoration reduced by 24.5% if they are below 40% HP.

npc_dota_hero_abaddon.name: Borrowed Time
npc_dota_hero_abaddon.description:
When activated, dispels you and all damage dealt to you will heal instead of harm. If the ability is not on cooldown, it will automatically activate if your health falls below 400.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

npc_dota_hero_elder_titan.name: Echo Stomp
npc_dota_hero_elder_titan.description: CHANNELED - Elder Titan and his Astral Spirit both stomp the ground, damaging and knocking nearby enemy units unconscious around their locations. The Elder Titan stomp deals physical damage, while the Spirit stomp deals magical damage.

npc_dota_hero_elder_titan.name: Astral Spirit
npc_dota_hero_elder_titan.description:
Elder Titan sends forth his Astral Spirit, damaging any units it passes through. When the spirit rejoins the Titan, it grants bonus damage and movement speed for each unit it passed through.

The Astral Spirit possesses the Echo Stomp, Return Spirit, and Natural Order abilities.

npc_dota_hero_elder_titan.name: Natural Order
npc_dota_hero_elder_titan.description: Reduces all elements to their basic levels, removing base armor and magic damage resistance from nearby enemy units. The armor reduction is centered around the hero, while the magic armor reduction is centered around Astral Spirit.

npc_dota_hero_elder_titan.name: Move Astral Spirit
npc_dota_hero_elder_titan.description: Moves the Astral Spirit to target location.

npc_dota_hero_elder_titan.name: Momentum
npc_dota_hero_elder_titan.description: Elder Titan gains armor equal to a percentage of his bonus movement speed.

npc_dota_hero_elder_titan.name: Earth Splitter
npc_dota_hero_elder_titan.description: Sends forth a jagged crack in front of Elder Titan. After 3 seconds, the crack implodes, slowing movement while dealing damage to each enemy based on their maximum life. Half of the damage dealt is Magical damage, while the other half is Physical damage.

npc_dota_hero_elder_titan.name: Return Astral Spirit
npc_dota_hero_elder_titan.description: Returns the Astral Spirit to Elder Titan.

npc_dota_hero_legion_commander.name: Overwhelming Odds
npc_dota_hero_legion_commander.description: Turns the foes' numbers against them, dealing a 100% impact slow for 0.3s and damage to all enemies in the area. Damage increases with each enemy unit or hero in the area, and grants Legion Commander bonus attack speed.

npc_dota_hero_legion_commander.name: Press The Attack
npc_dota_hero_legion_commander.description:
Removes debuffs and disables from the target friendly unit, and grants bonus movement speed and health regen for a short time.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

npc_dota_hero_legion_commander.name: Moment of Courage
npc_dota_hero_legion_commander.description: When attacked a number of times, Legion Commander will counter-attack her target with bonus lifesteal.

npc_dota_hero_legion_commander.name: Outfight Them!
npc_dota_hero_legion_commander.description:
Passively grants Legion Commander armor.

If Legion or an allied Hero within 1200 range casts an ability, they gain bonus armor for 6s; allies gain 50% of the value. This bonus stacks independently.

npc_dota_hero_legion_commander.name: Duel
npc_dota_hero_legion_commander.description: Legion Commander and the target enemy hero are forced to attack each other for a short duration. Neither hero can use items, and the target enemy hero cannot use abilities. If either hero dies during the duration, the hero winning the Duel gains permanent bonus damage.

npc_dota_hero_ember_spirit.name: Searing Chains
npc_dota_hero_ember_spirit.description: Ember Spirit unleashes fiery bolas that wrap around nearby enemies, anchoring them in place and dealing damage each second.

npc_dota_hero_ember_spirit.name: Sleight of Fist
npc_dota_hero_ember_spirit.description: Ember Spirit dashes around with blazing speed, attacking all enemies in the targeted area of effect, then returning to his start location. Deals bonus damage to heroes.

npc_dota_hero_ember_spirit.name: Flame Guard
npc_dota_hero_ember_spirit.description: Ember Spirit surrounds himself with a ring of fire that consumes incoming magic damage, absorbing a percentage of the damage taken. Flame Guard deals damage per second in an area around Ember Spirit while Flame Guard is active. If the shield is broken, the damage is also lost.

npc_dota_hero_ember_spirit.name: Activate Fire Remnant
npc_dota_hero_ember_spirit.description: Select the Fire Remnant to arrive at.

npc_dota_hero_ember_spirit.name: Immolation
npc_dota_hero_ember_spirit.description: Ember Spirit is continuously burning, dealing damage per second to all nearby enemies at all times.

npc_dota_hero_ember_spirit.name: Fire Remnant
npc_dota_hero_ember_spirit.description: Sends a Fire Remnant that runs to the target location at 250% Ember Spirit's speed. Using Activate Fire Remnant, Ember Spirit will dash out to all active Fire Remnants, destroying them and dealing damage in an area and then moving to the nearest Remnant. Ember Spirit will end at the Remnant closest to the targeted location.

npc_dota_hero_earth_spirit.name: Boulder Smash
npc_dota_hero_earth_spirit.description: Earth Spirit smashes the target enemy or ally, sending them in the direction he is facing. If Earth Spirit targets an area, he will smash the nearest unit in a 200 radius, prioritizing Stone Remnants. The travelling unit or Remnant damages all enemy units it hits. If an enemy is hit by a Stone Remnant, they are also slowed. Stone Remnants travel further than other units.

npc_dota_hero_earth_spirit.name: Rolling Boulder
npc_dota_hero_earth_spirit.description: Earth Spirit gathers himself into a boulder and, after a 0.6s delay, rolls toward the target location, dealing 60 + 100% STR damage and stunning enemy units. He will stop if he collides with an enemy hero or is stunned. If he rolls over a Stone Remnant, he will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer.
